00013   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE lookup(name,node,id,atoms,charge)
00014     !
00015     ! Purpose:
00016     !   This is a subroutine that compares a string value to values
00017     !  in a list and gives the index of a matching result and an
00018     !  error if there is no match.
00019     !
00020     !! LOOKUP !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00021     IMPLICIT NONE
00022     INTEGER            :: id, atoms, charge
00023     CHARACTER(len=10)  :: name
00024     TYPE(species) :: node
00025 
00026     IF ( TRIM(name) .EQ. TRIM(node%name) ) THEN
00027       id = node%id
00028       atoms = node%atoms
00029       charge = node%charge
00030       RETURN
00031     ELSE
00032       IF ( ASSOCIATED(node%next)) THEN
00033         CALL lookup(name,node%next,id,atoms,charge)
00034       ELSE
00035         id = -1
00036         PRINT *, "ERROR! No match!"
00037         CALL EXIT()
00038       END IF
00039     END IF
00040     RETURN
00041   END SUBROUTINE lookup

00043   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE writereactions(node)
00044     !
00045     ! Purpose:
00046     !   This is a subroutine that writes out the number of times each reaction
00047     !  has been called so far in the model
00048     !! WRITEREACTIONS !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00049     IMPLICIT NONE
00050     type(reaction) :: node
00051     character(80) :: varfmt
00052     character(80) :: cr1,cr2,cp1,cp2,cp3,cident
00053     integer :: yield
00054     real    :: tempsum
00055     character(30) :: nature
00056     character(30) :: basefile
00057     character(2) :: intnum
00058     integer :: n
00059 
00060     varfmt = "(3ES20.4,A35,A12)"
00061     basefile = "_reactions.wsv"
00062 
00063     if ( node%id .eq. num_reacts-1 ) then
00064       print *, node%id
00065     end if
00066 
00067     cr1 = node%r1
00068     cr2 = node%r2
00069     cp1 = node%p1
00070     cp2 = node%p2
00071     cp3 = node%p3
00072     cident = '    "'//trim(cr1)//&
00073       ' + '//trim(cr2)//&
00074       '->'//trim(cp1)//&
00075       ' + '//trim(cp2)//&
00076       ' + '//trim(cp3)//'"'
00077 
00078     DO n=1,NUM_SPECIES
00079       write(intnum,'(I2)') n
00080       !       print *, "Opening file=",TRIM(intnum)//basefile
00081       OPEN(file=intnum//basefile,unit=n+1000,position='APPEND',status='OLD')
00082       call analyzereaction(node,n,yield,nature)
00083       tempsum = abs(yield)*node%count
00084       if ( yield > 0 ) then
00085         if ( SP_PROD_DEST(n,1) .NE. 0 ) then
00086           tempsum = tempsum/REAL(SP_PROD_DEST(n,1))
00087         else
00088           tempsum = 0
00089         end if
00090       else if ( yield < 0 ) then
00091         if ( SP_PROD_DEST(n,2) .NE. 0 ) then
00092           tempsum = tempsum/REAL(SP_PROD_DEST(n,2))
00093         else
00094           tempsum = 0
00095         end if
00096       else
00097         continue
00098       end if
00099       write(n+1000,varfmt) tempsum, time, fluence, cident, nature
00100       close(n+1000)
00101     END DO
00102 
00103     node%count = 0
00104 
00105     IF ( ASSOCIATED(node%next)) THEN
00106       CALL writereactions(node%next)
00107     ELSE
00108       SP_PROD_DEST = 0
00109       RETURN
00110     END IF
00111   END SUBROUTINE writereactions

00113   SUBROUTINE hopping ( i_in, j_in, k_in, i_out, j_out, k_out, prob )
00114     !
00115     ! Purpose:
00116     !   The purpose of this  is to move a species from one site to another.
00117     !  It can move fr/ba/le/ri and up/down. Periodic boundary conditions are in
00118     !  place such that lateral motion moves to the other side of the lattice if
00119     !  it goes "overboard"
00120     !
00121     !! HOPPING !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00122     IMPLICIT NONE
00123     !*****************
00124     ! Input and output
00125     !*****************
00126     INTEGER            , INTENT(IN)                          :: i_in, j_in, k_in
00127     INTEGER            , INTENT(OUT)                         :: i_out, j_out, k_out
00128     INTEGER            , INTENT(IN)                          :: prob
00129 
00130     ! Determine the direction of travel based on input number
00131     ! note that the second and third indices, j and k, are
00132     ! incremented by +- 2
00133     SELECT CASE (prob)
00134     CASE (1)
00135       ! hop back => k-2
00136       IF ( k_in .EQ. 1 .OR. k_in .EQ. 2 ) THEN
00137         IF ( MOD(DIMENS(3),2) .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00138           IF ( k_in .EQ. 1 ) k_out = DIMENS(3)
00139           IF ( k_in .EQ. 2 ) k_out = DIMENS(3)-1
00140         ELSE
00141           IF ( k_in .EQ. 1 ) k_out = DIMENS(3)-1
00142           IF ( k_in .EQ. 2 ) k_out = DIMENS(3)
00143         END IF
00144       ELSE
00145         k_out = k_in-2
00146       END IF
00147       i_out = i_in
00148       j_out = j_in
00149     CASE (2)
00150       ! hop forward => k+2
00151       IF ( k_in .EQ. DIMENS(3) .OR. k_in .EQ. DIMENS(3)-1 ) THEN
00152         IF ( MOD(DIMENS(3),2) .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00153           IF ( k_in .EQ. DIMENS(3) ) k_out = 1
00154           IF ( k_in .EQ. DIMENS(3)-1 ) k_out = 2
00155         ELSE
00156           IF ( k_in .EQ. DIMENS(3) ) k_out = 2
00157           IF ( k_in .EQ. DIMENS(3)-1) k_out = 1
00158         END IF
00159       ELSE
00160         k_out = k_in + 2
00161       END IF
00162       i_out = i_in
00163       j_out = j_in
00164     CASE (3)
00165       ! hop left => j-2
00166       IF ( j_in .EQ. 1 .OR. j_in .EQ. 2 ) THEN
00167         IF ( MOD(DIMENS(2),2) .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00168           IF ( j_in .EQ. 1 ) j_out = DIMENS(2)
00169           IF ( j_in .EQ. 2 ) j_out = DIMENS(2)-1
00170         ELSE
00171           IF ( j_in .EQ. 1 ) j_out = DIMENS(2)-1
00172           IF ( j_in .EQ. 2 ) j_out = DIMENS(2)
00173         END IF
00174       ELSE
00175         j_out = j_in-2
00176       END IF
00177       i_out = i_in
00178       k_out = k_in
00179     CASE (4)
00180       ! hop right => j+2
00181       IF ( j_in .EQ. DIMENS(2) .OR. j_in .EQ. DIMENS(2)-1 ) THEN
00182         IF ( MOD(DIMENS(2),2) .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00183           IF ( j_in .EQ. DIMENS(2) ) j_out = 1
00184           IF ( j_in .EQ. DIMENS(2)-1) j_out = 2
00185         ELSE
00186           IF ( j_in .EQ. DIMENS(2)) j_out = 2
00187           IF ( j_in .EQ. DIMENS(2)-1) j_out = 1
00188         END IF
00189       ELSE
00190         j_out = j_in+2
00191       END IF
00192       i_out = i_in
00193       k_out = k_in
00194     CASE (5)
00195       ! hop down => i+1
00196       ! Hopping to the monolayer above or below the current
00197       ! one involves +- 1 to the first DIMENSion (i)
00198       IF ( i_in .EQ. DIMENS(1) ) THEN
00199         i_out = i_in
00200       ELSE
00201         i_out = i_in+1
00202       END IF
00203       j_out = j_in
00204       k_out = k_in
00205     CASE (6)
00206       ! hop up => i-1
00207       IF ( i_in .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00208         i_out = i_in
00209       ELSE
00210         i_out = i_in-1
00211       END IF
00212       j_out = j_in
00213       k_out = k_in
00214     END SELECT
00215   END SUBROUTINE hopping

00217   SUBROUTINE fallout ( root,temp,prevNode,nextNode)
00218     ! Purpose:
00219     !   To calculate the track of a particle of ionizing radiation through a
00220     !  crystaline solid.
00221     !
00222     ! Note:
00223     !   The input array, sigmas, contains the proton collision cross-sections.
00224     !
00225     ! Note:
00226     !   sgse is short for second-generation secondary eletron.
00227     !
00228     !! FALLOUT !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00229     IMPLICIT NONE
00230     INTEGER          :: null
00231     INTEGER                      :: num_elecs ! number of secondary electrons pruduced
00232     INTEGER                      :: num_izns
00233     INTEGER                      :: num_exs, num_els
00234     INTEGER                      :: x,y,z !coordinates of cosmic-ray along track
00235     INTEGER                      :: step !distance the track is incremented
00236     INTEGER                      :: switch
00237     INTEGER                      :: ev_coords(3)
00238     INTEGER                      :: prcoords(3)
00239     DOUBLE PRECISION               :: p,u,rand1 ! rand num
00240     DOUBLE PRECISION               :: sigma_tot !total cross-section
00241     DOUBLE PRECISION               :: mfp ! mean free path
00242     DOUBLE PRECISION               :: dz ! move dist
00243     DOUBLE PRECISION               :: dist_trav !distance travelled since last collision
00244     DOUBLE PRECISION               :: e_loss,e_ion,e_exc
00245     DOUBLE PRECISION               :: labtheta
00246     DOUBLE PRECISION     , TARGET  :: e_se
00247     DOUBLE PRECISION   , TARGET  :: energy_target
00248     DOUBLE PRECISION   , POINTER :: ione
00249     DOUBLE PRECISION   , POINTER :: psigij(:),psigexj(:)
00250     DOUBLE PRECISION   , POINTER :: o_psigij(:),o_psigexj(:)
00251     DOUBLE PRECISION   , POINTER :: o3_psigij(:),o3_psigexj(:)
00252     CHARACTER(len=15)            :: nature
00253     TYPE(SIGMA_BOX)    , POINTER :: psigmas(:)
00254     TYPE(SIGMA_BOX)    , POINTER :: o_psigmas(:)
00255     TYPE(SIGMA_BOX)    , POINTER :: o3_psigmas(:)
00256     TYPE(SE_INFO)                :: se_box
00257     !*************************************************************************
00258     !Proton cross-section data, to be phased out and replaced with a struct as
00259     !with se_box
00260     !*************************************************************************
00261     DOUBLE PRECISION, ALLOCATABLE, TARGET :: psigij_target(:),psigexj_target(:)
00262     TYPE(SIGMA_BOX),  ALLOCATABLE, TARGET :: psigmas_target(:)
00263     DOUBLE PRECISION, ALLOCATABLE, TARGET :: o_psigij_target(:),o_psigexj_target(:)
00264     TYPE(SIGMA_BOX),  ALLOCATABLE, TARGET :: o_psigmas_target(:)
00265     DOUBLE PRECISION, ALLOCATABLE, TARGET :: o3_psigij_target(:),o3_psigexj_target(:)
00266     TYPE(SIGMA_BOX),  ALLOCATABLE, TARGET :: o3_psigmas_target(:)
00267     INTEGER :: thinghit
00268     LOGICAL :: proceed
00269     TYPE(node), POINTER :: root,temp,prevNode,nextNode
00270 
00271     IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, '*****Starting Fallout*****'
00272     IF ( TRACKPLOT .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00273       CLOSE(TRACKPLOT_LUN)
00274       OPEN(UNIT=TRACKPLOT_LUN,FILE="trackplot.csv", STATUS='REPLACE')
00275     END IF
00276 
00277     !****************************************************************************!
00278     ! Preliminary  calculations                                                  !
00279     !****************************************************************************!
00280     count_count = 0
00281     BI_CALLS = 0
00282     PROTON_ELOSS = 0
00283     PROTON_COLL = 0
00284 
00285     ! Calculate the initial cross-sections based on the initial ion energy
00286     ! For O2
00287     ALLOCATE(psigmas_target(3))
00288     psigmas => psigmas_target
00289     ALLOCATE(psigij_target(SIZE(o2_p_ion)))
00290     psigij => psigij_target
00291     ALLOCATE(psigexj_target(SIZE(o2_p_ex)))
00292     psigexj => psigexj_target
00293 
00294     ! For O
00295     ALLOCATE(o_psigmas_target(3))
00296     o_psigmas => o_psigmas_target
00297     ALLOCATE(o_psigij_target(SIZE(o_p_ion)))
00298     o_psigij => o_psigij_target
00299     ALLOCATE(o_psigexj_target(SIZE(o_p_ex)))
00300     o_psigexj => o_psigexj_target
00301 
00302     ! For O3
00303     ALLOCATE(o3_psigmas_target(3))
00304     o3_psigmas => o3_psigmas_target
00305     ALLOCATE(o3_psigij_target(SIZE(o3_p_ion)))
00306     o3_psigij => o3_psigij_target
00307     ALLOCATE(o3_psigexj_target(SIZE(o3_p_ex)))
00308     o3_psigexj => o3_psigexj_target
00309 
00310     ione => energy_target
00311     ione = EINIT
00312     psigmas%cross_section = 0D0
00313     psigij  = 0D0
00314     psigexj = 0D0
00315     CALL psigma_suite(ione,&
00316       psigmas,psigij,psigexj,&
00317       o_psigmas,o_psigij,o_psigexj,&
00318       o3_psigmas,o3_psigij,o3_psigexj)
00319 
00320     ! Calculate the total cross-section and the mean free path
00321     ! Note, sigma_i is the inelastic ionization cross-section and
00322     ! sigma_e is the inelastic excitation cross section
00323     sigma_tot = SUM(psigmas%cross_section)
00324     mfp       = 1./(rho*sigma_tot)
00325 
00326     !****************************************************************************!
00327     ! Determine random entry site                                                !
00328     !****************************************************************************!
00329     proceed = .FALSE.
00330     IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, 'Now selecting initial site'
00331     DO WHILE ( proceed .EQV. .FALSE. )
00332       CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(p)
00333       CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(u)
00334       ! the value will be in range [1,bound]
00335       x = 1 + FLOOR( DIMENS(3)*p )
00336       y = 1 + FLOOR( DIMENS(2)*u )
00337       z = 1
00338       IF ( TRACKPLOT .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00339         PRINT *, "Trackplot on"
00340         IF ( x .GT. ((DIMENS(3)/2)-(DIMENS(3)*0.1)) .AND. &
00341           x .LT. ((DIMENS(3)/2)+(DIMENS(3)*0.1)) .AND. &
00342           y .GT. ((DIMENS(2)/2)-(DIMENS(2)*0.1)) .AND. &
00343           y .LT. ((DIMENS(2)/2)+(DIMENS(2)*0.1)) ) proceed = .TRUE.
00344       ELSE
00345         proceed = .TRUE.
00346       END IF
00347     END DO
00348 
00349     IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "The entry site is:",x,y,z
00350     !****************************************************************************!
00351     ! Beginning of track event calculation                                       !
00352     !****************************************************************************!
00353     dist_trav = 0
00354     dz        = 0
00355     step      = 0
00356 
00357     ! Repeat the section below until z + step is greater (in ml) than the
00358     ! thickness of the ice
00359     count_count = 0
00360     num_elecs   = 0
00361     num_izns    = 0
00362     num_exs     = 0
00363     num_els     = 0
00364 
00365     ! For writing out PDB format files...
00366     PMODEL = 0
00367 
00368     main_loop: DO WHILE ((z+step .LE. DIMENS(1)) .AND. (ione .GE. 5.0 ))
00369       IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, 'Now entering loop: z=',z,&
00370         ' and DIMENS(1)=',DIMENS(1), &
00371         ' and step=',step
00372       count_count = count_count + 1
00373 
00374       ! Define event coords
00375       ev_coords(1) = z+step
00376       ev_coords(2) = y
00377       ev_coords(3) = x
00378       IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "The event coords in Fallout are:",ev_coords
00379 
00380       thinghit = MATRIX(ev_coords(1),ev_coords(2),ev_coords(3))%sp_num
00381 
00382       IF ( thinghit .NE. 0 ) THEN
00383         IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "The value of the matrix is:",thinghit
00384         ! If the site is occupied, then determine the type of event to occur
00385         CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(u)
00386         CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rand1)
00387         !****************************************************************************!
00388         ! Determine the nature of the collision and the energy lost                  !
00389         !****************************************************************************!
00390         switch = 0
00391         e_loss = 0
00392         e_ion  = 0
00393         e_exc  = 0
00394         e_se   = 0
00395         ASSOCIATE ( sigma_i => psigmas(2)%cross_section, &
00396             sigma_e => psigmas(3)%cross_section )
00397           IF ( (u .GT. 0.0) .AND. (u .LE. (sigma_i + sigma_e)/sigma_tot) ) THEN
00398             IF ( (u .GT. 0) .AND. (u .LE. sigma_i/sigma_tot )) THEN
00399               ! Ionization will occur
00400               num_izns = num_izns + 1
00401               switch = 2
00402               CALL p_ion_select(psigij,e_ion,e_se,thinghit)
00403               e_loss = e_ion + e_se
00404               nature = "Ionization"
00405               PROTON_ELOSS = PROTON_ELOSS + e_loss
00406             ELSE
00407               ! Excitation will occur
00408               num_exs = num_exs + 1
00409               switch = 1
00410               CALL p_ex_select(psigexj,e_exc,thinghit)
00411               e_loss = e_exc
00412               nature = "Excitation"
00413               PROTON_ELOSS = PROTON_ELOSS + e_loss
00414             END IF
00415           ELSE
00416             ! Elastic Collision will occur
00417             num_els = num_els + 1
00418             switch = 0
00419             CALL elastic_event(ione,e_loss,labtheta)
00420             nature = "Elastic"
00421           END IF
00422         END ASSOCIATE
00423         PROTON_COLL = PROTON_COLL + 1
00424         PMODEL = PMODEL + 1
00425         ione = ione - e_loss
00426         CALL psigma_suite(ione,&
00427           psigmas,psigij,psigexj,&
00428           o_psigmas,o_psigij,o_psigexj,&
00429           o3_psigmas,o3_psigij,o3_psigexj)
00430 
00431         IF ( TRACKPLOT .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00432           count_count = count_count + 1
00433           CALL trackwrite(ev_coords,ione,0,.FALSE.)
00434         END IF
00435 
00436         IF ( switch .EQ. 0 ) THEN
00437           !****************************************************************************!
00438           ! Elastic collision                                                          !
00439           !****************************************************************************!
00440           !NB: FUTURE WORK TO ADD LATTICE DAMAGE
00441           CONTINUE
00442         ELSE IF ( switch .EQ. 1 ) THEN ! Dissociate target species on track and pla       !
00443           !****************************************************************************!
00444           ! Place excitation on site
00445           null = 0
00446           MATRIX(ev_coords(1),ev_coords(2),ev_coords(3))%sec_sp_num = EXCNUM
00447           prcoords = 1 ! Initialize product coordinates to 1 for recursive subroutine
00448           CALL new_reaction(ev_coords,ev_coords,prcoords,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,null)
00449           IF ( null .EQ. 1 ) RETURN
00450         ELSE IF ( switch .EQ. 2 .AND. z+step .NE. 1 .AND. z+step .NE. 2 ) THEN
00451           !****************************************************************************!
00452           ! Ionization                                                                 !
00453           !****************************************************************************!
00454           temp => MATRIX(ev_coords(1),ev_coords(2),ev_coords(3))
00455           ! Place CRP at secondary site for reaction
00456           temp%sec_sp_num = CRPNUM
00457           ! Initialize product coords
00458           prcoords = 1
00459           ! Call new_reaction to form electron
00460           CALL new_reaction(ev_coords,ev_coords,prcoords,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,null)
00461           IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, temp%sp_num, temp%sec_sp_num
00462           ! Test to make sure that the new reaction worked properly
00463           IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00464             IF ( (.NOT. ANY(IONLIST .EQ. temp%sp_num)) .OR. &
00465               (ELECNUM .NE. temp%sec_sp_num) ) THEN
00466             PRINT *, "Ionization not successful!! Products not as expected!"
00467             PRINT *, temp%sp_num
00468             PRINT *, temp%sec_sp_num
00469             CALL EXIT()
00470           END IF
00471         END IF
00472         ! Initialize se_box with initial energy and parent coords
00473         se_box%se_energy = e_se
00474         se_box%generation = 1
00475         IF ( SECELEC .EQV. .FALSE. ) se_box%se_energy = 0D0
00476         se_box%parent_coords = ev_coords
00477         CALL se_info_init(se_box)
00478         ! Call new_electron
00479         CALL new_electron(se_box,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode)
00480         !Manual garbage collection
00481         CALL se_info_garbage(se_box)
00482       END IF
00483     END IF
00484 
00485     !********************!
00486     ! Track Plotting bit !
00487     !********************!
00488     dist_trav = dist_trav + dz
00489     IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "z=",z,"of",DIMENS(1),&
00490       " which is",(REAL(z)/REAL(DIMENS(1)))*100,"% of thickness"
00491     ! Increment z for next cycle
00492     z = z + step
00493 
00494     !********************!
00495     ! GOTO jumps to here !
00496     !********************!
00497     ! Call a random number between [0,1)
00498     100    CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(p)
00499 
00500     ! Make sure the random number does not equal 1
00501     IF ( p .EQ. 1.0 ) THEN
00502       DO
00503         IF ( p .NE. 1.0 ) EXIT
00504         CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(p)
00505       END DO
00506     END IF
00507 
00508     ! Determine the travel distance
00509     dz = -mfp*LOG(1-p)
00510 
00511     ! Determine whether or not the site is occupied by dividing the
00512     ! Delta z by the height of the crystal cube, i.e. \Delta ml =
00513     ! \Delta z(m) * (1ml/c(m))
00514     IF ( fixed_step .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00515       step = STEPFAC
00516     ELSE
00517       step = INT((dz/(THICK/REAL(DIMENS(1)))))
00518     END IF
00519 
00520     ! Make sure the next site is different than the previous one
00521     IF ( z+step .EQ. z ) THEN
00522       z = z + 1
00523     END IF
00524 
00525     ! Make sure the site is greater than the previous one
00526     IF (step .LE. 0. ) GOTO 100
00527     IF (z+step .GE. DIMENS(1) ) THEN
00528       IF ( TRACKPLOT .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00529         IF ( (count_count .GT. TRACKMIN) .AND. (count_count .LT. TRACKMAX) ) THEN
00530           CALL EXIT()
00531         ELSE
00532           RETURN
00533         END IF
00534       ELSE
00535         RETURN
00536       END IF
00537     END IF
00538 
00539     IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, 'Now at end of main loop in Fallout'
00540     IF ( TRACKPLOT .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "count_count=",count_count
00541   END DO main_loop
00542 
00543   IF ( ( TRACKPLOT .EQV. .TRUE. ) .AND. (count_count .GE. TRACKMIN ) ) CALL EXIT()
00544   IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, '*****Ending Fallout*****'
00545 END SUBROUTINE fallout

00547 RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE find_empty_site( in_coords,out_coords,null )
00548   ! Purose:
00549   !   This subtroutine takes some ion/bulk interaction site and finds a nearby
00550   !  empty site to put a second product. The return of the function is a set of
00551   !  coordinates.
00552   !
00553   ! Note:
00554   !   null = 1 => no empty sites
00555   !   null = 0 => empty site available
00556   !
00557   !! FIND_EMPTY_SITE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00558   IMPLICIT NONE
00559   !*****************
00560   ! Input and output
00561   !*****************
00562   INTEGER            , INTENT(IN) , DIMENSION(3)               :: in_coords !coords of reaction site
00563   INTEGER            , INTENT(OUT), DIMENSION(3)               :: out_coords !coords for product
00564   INTEGER                                          :: null !null error flag
00565   !****************
00566   ! Local variables
00567   !****************
00568   INTEGER                                                      :: i, j, k
00569   INTEGER                                                      :: prev(3),curr(3),next(3)
00570   INTEGER                                                      :: large_count
00571   INTEGER                                                      :: small_count
00572   INTEGER                                                      :: lucky !index of selected site, from rand
00573   INTEGER                                                      :: n !counters
00574   INTEGER                                                      :: i_re, j_re, k_re !in coords
00575   INTEGER                                                      :: i_re2,j_re2,k_re2 !out coords
00576   INTEGER                         , DIMENSION(6,3)             :: large_temp
00577   INTEGER                         , DIMENSION(4,3)             :: small_temp
00578   INTEGER            , ALLOCATABLE, DIMENSION(:,:)             :: temp_arr !temporary empty site array
00579   REAL                                                         :: rand !random number
00580   LOGICAL                                                      :: vacant
00581 
00582   ! Initialize counters and arrays
00583   large_count   = 0
00584   small_count  = 0
00585 
00586   ! Assign i_re, j_re, k_re to in_coords
00587   i_re = in_coords(1)
00588   j_re = in_coords(2)
00589   k_re = in_coords(3)
00590 
00591   large_temp = 0
00592   small_temp = 0
00593   scc: DO n=1,6
00594     layercond: IF ( i_re .EQ. 1 .AND. ( n .EQ. 5 .OR. n .EQ. 6 ) ) THEN
00595       ! If on top layer, stay on top layer
00596       CONTINUE
00597     ELSE IF ( i_re .EQ. DIMENS(1) .AND. n .EQ. 6 ) THEN
00598       ! Don't hop down if on bottom layer
00599       CONTINUE
00600     ELSE
00601       CALL hopping(i_re,j_re,k_re,i_re2,j_re2,k_re2,n )
00602       IF ( (MATRIX(i_re2,j_re2,k_re2)%sp_num .EQ. 0) .AND. &
00603         (MATRIX(i_re2,j_re2,k_re2)%sec_sp_num .EQ. 0) ) THEN
00604       large_temp(n,1)=i_re2
00605       large_temp(n,2)=j_re2
00606       large_temp(n,3)=k_re2
00607       large_count = large_count + 1
00608     END IF
00609   END IF layercond
00610 END DO scc
00611 
00612 largecount: IF ( large_count .GT. 0 ) THEN
00613   CONTINUE
00614 ELSE
00615   phantom: DO n=1,4
00616     ! Go to a phantom position to hop to nearest neighbors
00617     SELECT CASE (n)
00618     CASE (1)
00619       IF ( (j_re-1 .GT. 0) .AND. (k_re-1 .GT. 0) .AND. (k_re+1 .LE. DIMENS(3))) THEN
00620         CALL hopping(i_re,j_re-1,k_re+1,i_re2,j_re2,k_re2,1)
00621       ELSE
00622         GOTO 1944
00623       END IF
00624 
00625     CASE (2)
00626       IF ( (j_re-1 .GT. 0) .AND. (k_re-1 .GT. 0) .AND. (k_re+1 .LE. DIMENS(3))) THEN
00627         CALL hopping(i_re,j_re-1,k_re-1,i_re2,j_re2,k_re2,2)
00628       ELSE
00629         GOTO 1944
00630       END IF
00631 
00632     CASE (3)
00633       IF ( (j_re+1 .LE. DIMENS(2)) .AND. (k_re-1 .GT. 0) .AND. (k_re+1 .LE. DIMENS(3))) THEN
00634         CALL hopping(i_re,j_re+1,k_re-1,i_re2,j_re2,k_re2,2)
00635       ELSE
00636         GOTO 1944
00637       END IF
00638 
00639     CASE (4)
00640       IF ( (j_re+1 .LE. DIMENS(2)) .AND. (k_re-1 .GT. 0) .AND. (k_re+1 .LE. DIMENS(3))) THEN
00641         CALL hopping(i_re,j_re+1,k_re+1,i_re2,j_re2,k_re2,1)
00642       ELSE
00643         GOTO 1944
00644       END IF
00645     END SELECT
00646 
00647     IF ( (MATRIX(i_re2,j_re2,k_re2)%sp_num .EQ. 0) .AND. &
00648       (MATRIX(i_re2,j_re2,k_re2)%sec_sp_num .EQ. 0) ) THEN
00649     small_temp(n,1)=i_re2
00650     small_temp(n,2)=j_re2
00651     small_temp(n,3)=k_re2
00652     small_count = small_count + 1
00653   END IF
00654   1944      CONTINUE
00655 END DO phantom
00656     END IF largecount
00657 
00658     ! Determine if there has been a null event
00659     nullevent: IF ( large_count .EQ. 0 .AND. small_count .EQ. 0 ) THEN
00660       checkall: IF ( FIND_EMPTY_COUNT .GT. FINDMAX ) THEN
00661         DO i = 1,DIMENS(3)
00662           DO j = 1,DIMENS(2)
00663             DO k = 1,DIMENS(1)
00664               isempty: IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. 0 ) THEN
00665                 out_coords(1) = i
00666                 out_coords(2) = j
00667                 out_coords(3) = k
00668                 null = 0
00669                 RETURN
00670               END IF isempty
00671             END DO
00672           END DO
00673         END DO
00674         PRINT *, "Could not find site in all matrix!!!!"
00675         CALL EXIT()
00676       ELSE
00677         IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE.) PRINT *, "314159!"
00678         vacant = .TRUE.
00679         curr = in_coords
00680         next = in_coords
00681         movefind: DO WHILE ( vacant .EQV. .TRUE. )
00682           FIND_EMPTY_COUNT = FIND_EMPTY_COUNT + 1
00683           prev = curr
00684           curr = next
00685           CALL transport(prev,curr,next)
00686           CALL find_empty_site(next,out_coords,null)
00687           IF ( null .EQ. 0 ) vacant = .FALSE.
00688         END DO movefind
00689         RETURN
00690       END IF checkall
00691     ELSE
00692       FIND_EMPTY_COUNT = 0
00693       null = 0
00694     END IF nullevent
00695 
00696     ! populate the temp_arr such that it consists of only
00697     ! coordinates where there are empty spaces
00698     i = 1
00699     IF ( large_count .EQ. 0 ) THEN
00700       ALLOCATE( temp_arr(small_count,3) )
00701       temp_arr = 0
00702       n = 0
00703       DO n=1,SIZE(small_temp,1)
00704         IF ( ANY( small_temp(n,:) .NE. 0 ) ) THEN
00705           temp_arr(i,1) = small_temp(n,1)
00706           temp_arr(i,2) = small_temp(n,2)
00707           temp_arr(i,3) = small_temp(n,3)
00708           i = i + 1
00709         ELSE
00710           CONTINUE
00711         END IF
00712       END DO
00713     ELSE
00714       ALLOCATE( temp_arr(large_count,3) )
00715       temp_arr = 0
00716       n = 0
00717       DO n=1,SIZE(large_temp,1)
00718         IF ( ANY( large_temp(n,:) .NE. 0 ) ) THEN
00719           temp_arr(i,1) = large_temp(n,1)
00720           temp_arr(i,2) = large_temp(n,2)
00721           temp_arr(i,3) = large_temp(n,3)
00722           i = i + 1
00723         ELSE
00724           CONTINUE
00725         END IF
00726       END DO
00727     END IF
00728 
00729     ! choose one at random
00730     CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rand)
00731     out_coords=0
00732     IF (SIZE(temp_arr,1) .EQ. 1) THEN
00733       n=0
00734       DO n=1,3
00735         out_coords(n) = temp_arr(1,n)
00736       END DO
00737     ELSE
00738       IF ( large_count .NE. 0 ) THEN
00739         lucky = INT(rand*large_count) + 1
00740         n=0
00741         DO n=1,3
00742           out_coords(n) = temp_arr(lucky,n)
00743         END DO
00744       ELSE
00745         lucky = INT(rand*small_count) + 1
00746         n=0
00747         DO n=1,3
00748           out_coords(n) = temp_arr(lucky,n)
00749         END DO
00750       END IF
00751     END IF
00752   END SUBROUTINE find_empty_site
00753 
00754   SUBROUTINE wait_calc ( temp )
00755     !
00756     ! Purpose:
00757     !  The purpose of this subroutine is to calculate
00758     ! waiting times for some species and save these
00759     ! values to the waiting list
00760     !
00761     ! Note: for information on rates, see the description
00762     !  in Chang and Herbst 2014, hereafter CH14
00763     !
00764     ! Note: As described in CH14, the rate, b, is
00765     !  different for surface and bulk species.
00766     !  For surface species, which can either
00767     !  desorb or diffuse, b = b_desorb + b_diff. On the
00768     !  other hand, for bulk species, b = b_bulkdiff.
00769     !
00770     ! Documentation:
00771     !  DATE          PROGRAMMER           DESCRIPTION
00772     !  ========      ==========           ===========
00773     !  20150414      C. Shingledecker     Original code
00774     !
00775     !
00776     !  This subroutine changes the following properties in the node
00777     !  1) wait_time
00778     !  2) hop_dir
00779     !  3) act_type
00780     !
00781     !! WAIT_CALC !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00782     IMPLICIT NONE
00783     TYPE(node), POINTER :: temp
00784     INTEGER             :: n
00785     INTEGER             :: ix,iy,iz
00786     DOUBLE PRECISION                                       :: rand_num  !pseudorandom number
00787     DOUBLE PRECISION                                       :: b_1       !surface thermal hopping rate
00788     DOUBLE PRECISION                                       :: b_2       !surface desorption rate
00789     DOUBLE PRECISION                                       :: b_3       !bulk diffusion rate
00790     DOUBLE PRECISION                                       :: b         !total rate, from CH14
00791     DOUBLE PRECISION                                       :: comp_val
00792     DOUBLE PRECISION                                       :: el_tmp
00793 
00794     ! Initialize variables
00795     el_tmp = 0
00796 
00797     ! Decide whether or not the species is on the surface
00798     IF ( temp%coord1 .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00799       DO n=1,5
00800         CALL hopping(temp%coord1,temp%coord2,temp%coord3,ix,iy,iz,n)
00801         IF ( MATRIX(ix,iy,iz)%sp_num .NE. 0 ) el_tmp = el_tmp + 0.1*EN_LIST(MATRIX(ix,iy,iz)%sp_num)
00802       END DO
00803       ! Surface species, separate rates for
00804       ! desorption and diffusion
00805       b_1 = trl_nu*EXP( -1*((EN_LIST(temp%sp_num)*E_SURF + el_tmp) / kin_temp ) )
00806       b_2 = trl_nu*EXP( -1*((EN_LIST(temp%sp_num) + el_tmp) / kin_temp ) )
00807       b = b_1 + b_2
00808       comp_val = b_1 / (b_1 + b_2)
00809       CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rand_num)
00810       ! Decide whether desorption or hopping occurs
00811       IF ( rand_num .LT. comp_val ) THEN
00812         ! Diffusion occurs
00813         temp%act_type = 1
00814       ELSE
00815         ! Desorption occurs
00816         temp%act_type = 2
00817       END IF
00818     ELSE
00819       ! Bulk species, only bulk diffusion
00820       IF ( (matrix(temp%coord1,temp%coord2,temp%coord3)%normal .eqv. .true.) .and. &
00821         (.not. any(fast_reacts .eq. temp%sp_num)) ) THEN
00822       DO n=1,5
00823         CALL hopping(temp%coord1,temp%coord2,temp%coord3,ix,iy,iz,n)
00824         IF ( MATRIX(ix,iy,iz)%sp_num .NE. 0 ) el_tmp = el_tmp + 0.1*EN_LIST(MATRIX(ix,iy,iz)%sp_num)
00825       END DO
00826       b_3 = trl_nu*EXP( -1*((EN_LIST(temp%sp_num)*E_BULK + el_tmp)/ kin_temp ) )
00827     ELSE
00828       b_3 = trl_nu*EXP( -1*( EN_LIST(temp%sp_num)*E_BULK     / kin_temp ) )
00829     END IF
00830     if ( (any(fast_reacts .eq. temp%sp_num)) .and. (temp%sp_num .ne. onum) ) then
00831       b = TRL_NU 
00832     else
00833       b = b_3
00834     end if
00835     ! Only hopping (diffusion) can occur
00836     temp%act_type = 1
00837   END IF
00838 
00839   ! Calculate waiting time
00840   CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rand_num)
00841   temp%wait_time = (-1*LOG(rand_num) / b) + TIME
00842 
00843   ! Get hopping direction
00844   temp%hop_dir = 1 + FLOOR((6+1-1)*rand_num)
00845   IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00846     ! Test for hopping in ranges
00847     IF ( (temp%hop_dir .GT. 6) .OR. (temp%hop_dir .LT. 1) ) THEN
00848       PRINT *, "Hopping out of ranges!"
00849       CALL EXIT()
00850     END IF
00851   END IF
00852 END SUBROUTINE wait_calc
00853 
00854 SUBROUTINE counter()
00855   !
00856   ! Purpose:
00857   !   The purpose of this subroutine is to count
00858   !  the number of each species in the matrix and
00859   !  print this information out to a file. These
00860   !  data shows the abundance as a function of time.
00861   !
00862   ! Documentation:
00863   !  DATE          PROGRAMMER           DESCRIPTION
00864   !  ========      ==========           ===========
00865   !  20150427      C. Shingledecker     Original code
00866   !
00867   !! COUNTER !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00868   IMPLICIT NONE
00869   INTEGER                                                    :: i,j,k
00870   INTEGER                                                    :: o_count,o2_count,o3_count
00871   integer :: ostarcount,o2starcount,o3starcount
00872   integer :: numatoms, othercount
00873   DOUBLE PRECISION                                             :: denom
00874   DOUBLE PRECISION                                             :: area
00875   CHARACTER(len=80)                                          :: varfmt
00876 
00877   area   = EDGE*EDGE
00878   denom = THICK*EDGE*EDGE*1.0E20
00879   o_count = 0
00880   o2_count = 0
00881   o3_count = 0
00882   ostarcount = 0
00883   o2starcount = 0
00884   o3starcount = 0
00885   othercount = 0
00886 
00887   DO k = 1,DIMENS(3)
00888     DO j = 1,DIMENS(2)
00889       DO i = 1,DIMENS(1)
00890         IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. O3NUM ) THEN
00891           o3_count = o3_count + 1
00892         ELSE IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. O2NUM ) THEN
00893           o2_count = o2_count + 1
00894         ELSE IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. ONUM ) THEN
00895           o_count = o_count + 1
00896         ELSE IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. ONUM ) THEN
00897           o_count = o_count + 1
00898         ELSE IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. OSTARNUM ) THEN
00899           ostarcount = ostarcount + 1
00900         ELSE IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. O2STARNUM ) THEN
00901           o2starcount = o2starcount + 1
00902         ELSE IF ( MATRIX(i,j,k)%sp_num .EQ. O3STARNUM ) THEN
00903           o3starcount = o3starcount + 1
00904         ELSE IF ( matrix(i,j,k)%sp_num .NE. 0 ) THEN
00905           othercount = othercount + 1
00906         END IF
00907       END DO
00908     END DO
00909   END DO
00910 
00911   O_ABUNDANCE  = o_count
00912   O2_ABUNDANCE = o2_count
00913   O3_ABUNDANCE = o3_count
00914 
00915   numatoms = o_count + (2*o2_count) + (3*o3_count)
00916   numatoms = numatoms + ostarcount + (2*o2starcount) + (3*o3starcount)
00917   IF ( numatoms .NE. initialatoms ) THEN
00918     print *, numatoms,"<",initialatoms
00919     call exit()
00920   end if
00921 
00922 
00923   ! Write output
00924   IF ( NO_OUTPUT .EQV. .FALSE. ) THEN
00925     varfmt = "(2ES15.4,7I10)"
00926     WRITE(AB_LUN,varfmt) &
00927       FLUENCE, & ! 1. Float64
00928       TIME,    & ! 3. Float64
00929       o2_count, & ! 4. Int64
00930       o_count, & ! 5. Int64
00931       o3_count, &          ! 6. Int64
00932       ostarcount, &
00933       o2starcount, &
00934       o3starcount, &
00935       numatoms
00936   END IF
00937 
00938   GVALUE = 0
00939   GVALUE = CUIRCT(:)/(TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS/100.0)
00940   varfmt = "(9ES15.4)"
00941   WRITE(GEMINACY_LUN,varfmt) &
00942     GVALUE(1), &
00943     SP_PROD_DEST(ONUM,1)/(TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS/100.0), &
00944     (SP_PROD_DEST(ONUM,1)-SP_PROD_DEST(ONUM,2))/(TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS/100.0), &
00945     GVALUE(2), &
00946     SP_PROD_DEST(O2NUM,1)/(TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS/100.0), &
00947     (SP_PROD_DEST(O2NUM,1)-SP_PROD_DEST(O2NUM,2))/(TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS/100.0), &
00948     GVALUE(3), &
00949     SP_PROD_DEST(O3NUM,1)/(TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS/100.0), &
00950     (SP_PROD_DEST(O3NUM,1)-SP_PROD_DEST(O3NUM,2))/(TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS/100.0)
00951 
00952   CUIRCT = 0
00953   TOTAL_PROTON_ELOSS = 0
00954 
00955   if ( o3_analytics .eqv. .true. ) call writereactions(RE_HEAD)
00956 
00957 
00958   IF ( QUIET .EQV. .FALSE. ) THEN
00959     varfmt = "(A6,ES10.4,A9,ES10.4)"
00960     PRINT varfmt, " TIME=",TIME,"FLUENCE=",fluence
00961     varfmt = "(A5,ES10.4,A6,ES10.4)"
00962     PRINT varfmt, " [O]=",o_count/denom," [O3]=",o3_count/denom
00963     PRINT *, '***********************************************************************'
00964     PRINT *, "O=",O_ABUNDANCE,"O2=",o2_count,"O3=",O3_ABUNDANCE
00965     PRINT *, "O*=",ostarcount,"O2*=",o2starcount,"O3*=",o3starcount
00966     print *, "numatoms=",numatoms, "othercount=",othercount
00967     PRINT *, '***********************************************************************'
00968 
00969   END IF
00970 END SUBROUTINE counter
00971 
00972 SUBROUTINE transport(prev,curr,next)
00973   !
00974   ! Purpose:
00975   !    The purpose of this subroutine is to calculate the next step in the bulk
00976   !   scattering and diffusion of secondary electrons in a solid.
00977   !
00978   ! Documentation:
00979   !  DATE          PROGRAMMER           DESCRIPTION
00980   !  ========      ==========           ===========
00981   !  20150811      C. Shingledecker     Original code
00982   !
00983   !! TRANSPORT !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
00984   IMPLICIT NONE
00985   INTEGER            , INTENT(IN)          , DIMENSION(3)     :: prev !coordinates of previous location
00986   INTEGER            , INTENT(IN)          , DIMENSION(3)     :: curr !current coordinates
00987   INTEGER            , INTENT(OUT)         , DIMENSION(3)     :: next !coordinates of next position
00988 
00989   !****************
00990   ! Local variables
00991   !****************
00992   INTEGER                                                      :: n !counters
00993   REAL                                                         :: insides
00994   REAL                                                         :: hopdist,nextdist
00995   REAL                                                         :: rand,rand2 !random number
00996   REAL                                                         :: sigma
00997   LOGICAL                                                      :: carnap
00998 
00999   insides = (curr(2)-prev(2))**2 + (curr(3)-prev(3))**2 + (curr(1)-prev(1))**2
01000   hopdist = SQRT( insides  )
01001 
01002   sigma = 0.0
01003   carnap = .FALSE.
01004   rand = 0.0
01005   rand2 = 0.0
01006   n = 0
01007   next = curr
01008   DO WHILE ( carnap .EQV. .FALSE. )
01009     !    PRINT *, 'prev=',prev
01010     !    PRINT *, 'curr=',curr
01011     CALL RANDOM_NUMBER( rand )
01012     CALL RANDOM_NUMBER( rand2 )
01013     IF ( rand .LE. 0.6 ) THEN
01014       n = 1 + FLOOR(6*rand2)
01015       IF ( curr(1) .EQ. 1 .AND. ( n .EQ. 5 .OR. n .EQ. 6 ) ) THEN
01016         ! If on top layer, stay on top layer
01017         CONTINUE
01018       ELSE IF ( curr(1) .EQ. DIMENS(1) .AND. n .EQ. 6 ) THEN
01019         ! Don't hop down if on bottom layer
01020         CONTINUE
01021       ELSE
01022         CALL hopping(curr(1),curr(2),curr(3),next(1),next(2),next(3),n )
01023       END IF
01024     ELSE
01025       n = 1 + FLOOR(4*rand2)
01026       ! Go to a phantom position to hop to nearest neighbors
01027       SELECT CASE (n)
01028       CASE (1)
01029         IF ( curr(2)-1 .GT. 0          .AND. &
01030           curr(3)-1 .GT. 0          .AND. &
01031           curr(3)+1 .LE. DIMENS(3) ) THEN
01032         CALL hopping(curr(1),curr(2)-1,curr(3)+1,next(1),next(2),next(3),1)
01033       ELSE
01034         CONTINUE
01035       END IF
01036     CASE (2)
01037       IF ( curr(2)-1 .GT. 0          .AND. &
01038         curr(3)-1 .GT. 0          .AND. &
01039         curr(3)+1 .LE. DIMENS(3) ) THEN
01040       CALL hopping(curr(1),curr(2)-1,curr(3)-1,next(1),next(2),next(3),2)
01041     ELSE
01042       CONTINUE
01043     END IF
01044   CASE (3)
01045     IF ( curr(2)+1 .LE. DIMENS(2)  .AND. &
01046       curr(3)-1 .GT. 0          .AND. &
01047       curr(3)+1 .LE. DIMENS(3) ) THEN
01048     CALL hopping(curr(1),curr(2)+1,curr(3)-1,next(1),next(2),next(3),2)
01049   ELSE
01050     CONTINUE
01051   END IF
01052 CASE (4)
01053   IF ( curr(2)+1 .LE. DIMENS(2)  .AND. &
01054     curr(3)-1 .GT. 0          .AND. &
01055     curr(3)+1 .LE. DIMENS(3) ) THEN
01056   CALL hopping(curr(1),curr(2)+1,curr(3)+1,next(1),next(2),next(3),1)
01057 ELSE
01058   CONTINUE
01059 END IF
01060           END SELECT
01061         END IF
01062         IF ( n .NE. 5 .AND. n .NE. 6 ) THEN
01063           insides = (next(2)-prev(2))**2 + (next(3)-prev(3))**2
01064           sigma = SQRT( insides )
01065           insides = (next(2)-curr(2))**2 + (next(3)-curr(3))**2 + (next(1)-curr(1))**2
01066           nextdist = SQRT( insides )
01067           IF ( nextdist .NE. 0.0 ) THEN
01068             !        PRINT *, 'hopdist=',hopdist,'nextdist=',nextdist,'sigma=',sigma
01069             IF ( hopdist .LT. 2.0 .AND. sigma .GE. 2.0 ) THEN
01070               carnap = .TRUE.
01071             ELSE IF ( hopdist .GE. 2.0 .AND. sigma .GT. 3.0 ) THEN
01072               carnap = .TRUE.
01073             ELSE
01074               CONTINUE
01075             END IF
01076           ELSE
01077             CONTINUE
01078           END IF
01079         ELSE IF ( n .EQ.5 .OR. n .EQ. 6 ) THEN
01080           carnap = .TRUE.
01081         END IF
01082         !    PRINT *, 'next=',next
01083         !    PRINT *, 'hopdist=',hopdist,'sigma=',sigma,'carnap=',carnap
01084       END DO
01085       !  PRINT *, n
01086       RETURN
01087     END SUBROUTINE transport
01088 
01089     SUBROUTINE psigma_suite(energy,&
01090         psigmas,psigij,psigexj,&
01091         o_psigmas,o_psigij,o_psigexj,&
01092         o3_psigmas,o3_psigij,o3_psigexj)
01093       !
01094       ! Purpose:
01095       !   This subroutine is to calculate a new batch of PROTON cross-sections
01096       ! either at the beginning of the simulation, or after an energy-loss event,
01097       ! i.e. a collision.
01098       !
01099       ! Note:
01100       !   This subroutine calculates three cross-sections: elastic, ionization, and
01101       ! excitation.
01102       !
01103       ! Note:
01104       !   The Green-McNeal formalism is used for both proton ionization and
01105       ! excitation.
01106       !
01107       !! PSIGMA_SUITE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01108       IMPLICIT NONE
01109 
01110       !Data dictionary: Input parameters
01111       DOUBLE PRECISION, POINTER               :: energy
01112       TYPE(SIGMA_BOX) , POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: psigmas
01113       DOUBLE PRECISION, POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: psigij,psigexj
01114       TYPE(SIGMA_BOX) , POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: o_psigmas
01115       DOUBLE PRECISION, POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: o_psigij,o_psigexj
01116       TYPE(SIGMA_BOX) , POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: o3_psigmas
01117       DOUBLE PRECISION, POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: o3_psigij,o3_psigexj
01118 
01119       !Data dictionary: Local variables
01120       INTEGER                                 :: n
01121       DOUBLE PRECISION                        :: scr_len
01122       DOUBLE PRECISION                        :: lss_en
01123       DOUBLE PRECISION                        :: massfac
01124       DOUBLE PRECISION                        :: sn_e
01125       DOUBLE PRECISION                        :: sn_eps
01126 
01127       !!!! For O3 !!!!
01128       !(1) Calculate elastic cross-section
01129       !i. calculate screening length
01130       scr_len = au(ZP,ZO3)
01131       !ii. calculate mass-factor
01132       massfac = mass_fac(MP,MO3)
01133       !iii. calculate reduced energy
01134       lss_en = eps(energy,ZP,ZO3,MP,MO3,scr_len)
01135       !iv. calculate reduced energy stopping cross-section
01136       sn_eps = sneps(lss_en)
01137       !v. calculate stopping cross-section
01138       sn_e = sne(sn_eps,ZP,ZO3,MP,MO3)
01139       !vi. calculate elastic collision cross-section
01140       o3_psigmas(1)%cross_section = pelsig(energy,sn_e,massfac)
01141       o3_psigmas(1)%description   = 'Elastic'
01142 
01143       !(2) Calculate ionization cross-section
01144       ASSOCIATE( a => o3_p_ion(1)%a_epgion, &
01145           j => o3_p_ion(1)%j_epgion, &
01146           v => o3_p_ion(1)%nu_epgion, &
01147           o => o3_p_ion(1)%omega_epgion, &
01148           i => o3_p_ion(1)%i_epgion )
01149         o3_psigij(1) = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO3,i)
01150       END ASSOCIATE
01151       o3_psigmas(2)%cross_section = SUM(o3_psigij)
01152       o3_psigmas(2)%description = 'Ionization'
01153 
01154       !(3) Calculate excitation cross-section
01155       ASSOCIATE( a => o3_p_ex(1)%a_epgex, &
01156           j => o3_p_ex(1)%j_epgex, &
01157           v => o3_p_ex(1)%nu_epgex, &
01158           o => o3_p_ex(1)%omega_epgex )
01159         o3_psigexj(1) = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO3,0D0)
01160       END ASSOCIATE
01161       o3_psigmas(3)%cross_section = SUM(o3_psigexj)
01162       o3_psigmas(3)%description    = 'Excitation'
01163 
01164 
01165       !!!! For O2 !!!!
01166       !(1) Calculate elastic cross-section
01167       !i. calculate screening length
01168       scr_len = au(ZP,ZO2)
01169       !ii. calculate mass-factor
01170       massfac = mass_fac(MP,MO2)
01171       !iii. calculate reduced energy
01172       lss_en = eps(energy,ZP,ZO2,MP,MO2,scr_len)
01173       !iv. calculate reduced energy stopping cross-section
01174       sn_eps = sneps(lss_en)
01175       !v. calculate stopping cross-section
01176       sn_e = sne(sn_eps,ZP,ZO2,MP,MO2)
01177       !vi. calculate elastic collision cross-section
01178       psigmas(1)%cross_section = pelsig(energy,sn_e,massfac)
01179       psigmas(1)%description   = 'Elastic'
01180 
01181       !(2) Calculate ionization cross-section
01182       DO n=1,SIZE(o2_p_ion)
01183         ASSOCIATE( a => o2_p_ion(n)%a_epgion, &
01184             j => o2_p_ion(n)%j_epgion, &
01185             v => o2_p_ion(n)%nu_epgion, &
01186             o => o2_p_ion(n)%omega_epgion, &
01187             i => o2_p_ion(n)%i_epgion )
01188           psigij(n) = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO2,i)
01189         END ASSOCIATE
01190       END DO
01191       psigmas(2)%cross_section = SUM(psigij)
01192       psigmas(2)%description = 'Ionization'
01193 
01194       !(3) Calculate excitation cross-section
01195       DO n=1,SIZE(o2_p_ex)
01196         ASSOCIATE( a => o2_p_ex(n)%a_epgex, &
01197             j => o2_p_ex(n)%j_epgex, &
01198             v => o2_p_ex(n)%nu_epgex, &
01199             o => o2_p_ex(n)%omega_epgex )
01200           psigexj(n) = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO2,0D0)
01201         END ASSOCIATE
01202       END DO
01203       psigmas(3)%cross_section = SUM(psigexj)
01204       psigmas(3)%description    = 'Excitation'
01205 
01206       !!!! For O !!!!
01207       !(1) Calculate elastic cross-section
01208       !i. calculate screening length
01209       scr_len = au(ZP,ZO1)
01210       !ii. calculate mass-factor
01211       massfac = mass_fac(MP,MO1)
01212       !iii. calculate reduced energy
01213       lss_en = eps(energy,ZP,ZO1,MP,MO1,scr_len)
01214       !iv. calculate reduced energy stopping cross-section
01215       sn_eps = sneps(lss_en)
01216       !v. calculate stopping cross-section
01217       sn_e = sne(sn_eps,ZP,ZO1,MP,MO1)
01218       !vi. calculate elastic collision cross-section
01219       o_psigmas(1)%cross_section = pelsig(energy,sn_e,massfac)
01220       o_psigmas(1)%description   = 'Elastic'
01221 
01222       !(2) Calculate ionization cross-section
01223       DO n=1,SIZE(o_p_ion)
01224         ASSOCIATE( a => o_p_ion(n)%a_epgion, &
01225             j => o_p_ion(n)%j_epgion, &
01226             v => o_p_ion(n)%nu_epgion, &
01227             o => o_p_ion(n)%omega_epgion, &
01228             i => o_p_ion(n)%i_epgion )
01229           o_psigij(n) = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO1,i)
01230         END ASSOCIATE
01231       END DO
01232       o_psigmas(2)%cross_section = SUM(o_psigij)
01233       o_psigmas(2)%description = 'Ionization'
01234 
01235       !(3) Calculate excitation cross-section
01236       DO n=1,SIZE(o_p_ex)
01237         ASSOCIATE( a => o_p_ex(n)%a_epgex, &
01238             j => o_p_ex(n)%j_epgex, &
01239             v => o_p_ex(n)%nu_epgex, &
01240             o => o_p_ex(n)%omega_epgex )
01241           o_psigexj(n) = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO1,0D0)
01242         END ASSOCIATE
01243       END DO
01244       o_psigmas(3)%cross_section = SUM(o_psigexj)
01245       o_psigmas(3)%description    = 'Excitation'
01246     END SUBROUTINE psigma_suite
01247 
01248     SUBROUTINE esigma_suite(se_box)
01249       !
01250       ! Purpose:
01251       !   This subroutine is to calculate a set of ELECTRON cross-sections
01252       ! either at the beginning of the simulation, or after an energy-loss event,
01253       ! i.e. a collision.
01254       !
01255       ! Note:
01256       !   This subroutine calculates three cross-sections: elastic, ionization, and
01257       ! excitation.
01258       !
01259       ! Note:
01260       !   The ionization cross-section makes use of the formalism described in
01261       ! Green and Sawada (1972)
01262       !
01263       ! Note:
01264       !   The Porter, Jackman, and Green formalism is used for allowed transitions
01265       ! and the Green-Dutta (1967) formalism is used for forbidden transitions.
01266       !
01267       !! ESIGMA_SUITE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01268       IMPLICIT NONE
01269 
01270       !Data dictionary: Input parameters
01271       TYPE(se_info)                      :: se_box
01272 
01273       !Data dictionary: Local variables
01274       INTEGER                                 :: n
01275       DOUBLE PRECISION                        :: ae,ge,tnaught,tmax
01276 
01277       ! FOR O3 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01278       !(2) Calculate ionization cross-section
01279       ASSOCIATE( &
01280           energy => se_box%se_energy, &
01281           a => o3_p_ion(1)%a_epgion, &
01282           j => o3_p_ion(1)%j_epgion, &
01283           v => o3_p_ion(1)%nu_epgion, &
01284           o => o3_p_ion(1)%omega_epgion, &
01285           i => o3_p_ion(1)%i_epgion )
01286         se_box%se_o3_iontot = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO3,i)
01287       END ASSOCIATE
01288 
01289       !(3) Calculate excitation cross-section
01290       ASSOCIATE( &
01291           energy => se_box%se_energy, &
01292           a => o3_p_ex(1)%a_epgex, &
01293           j => o3_p_ex(1)%j_epgex, &
01294           v => o3_p_ex(1)%nu_epgex, &
01295           o => o3_p_ex(1)%omega_epgex )
01296         se_box%se_o3_extot = green_mcneal(energy,a,j,v,o,ZO3,0D0)
01297       END ASSOCIATE
01298 
01299 
01300 
01301       ! FOR O2 !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01302       !(0) Initialize se_box
01303       !(1) Initialize variables
01304       n = 0
01305       ae = 0
01306       ge = 0
01307       tnaught = 0
01308       tmax = 0
01309 
01310       !(2) Calculate ionization cross-section
01311       DO n=1,SIZE(se_box%se_ionst)
01312         ASSOCIATE ( en  => se_box%se_energy           , &
01313             i   => se_box%se_ionst(n)%i_energy, &
01314             k   => se_box%se_ionst(n)%k_ion   , &
01315             kb  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%kb_ion  , &
01316             j   => se_box%se_ionst(n)%j_ion   , &
01317             jb  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%jb_ion  , &
01318             jc  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%jc_ion  , &
01319             gs  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%gams_ion, &
01320             gb  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%gamb_ion, &
01321             ts  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%ts_ion  , &
01322             ta  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%ta_ion  , &
01323             tb  => se_box%se_ionst(n)%tb_ion  , &
01324             sig => se_box%se_ionsigs(n)          )
01325           IF ( en .LT. i ) THEN
01326             sig = 0D0
01327           ELSE
01328             !i. Calculate the A(E) value from Green & Sawada
01329             ae = a_gs(en,k,kb,j,jb,jc)
01330             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' ae=',ae
01331             !ii. Calculate the \Gamma(E) factor
01332             ge = gamma_gs(en,gs,gb)
01333             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' ge=',ge
01334             !iii. Calculate the T_0 value
01335             tnaught = t_0_gs(en,ta,tb,ts)
01336             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' tnaught=',tnaught
01337             !iv. Calculate the Tmas value
01338             tmax = t_max_gs(en,i)
01339             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' tmax=',tmax
01340             !v. Calculate the cross-section for the state
01341             sig = green_sawada(ae,ge,tmax,tnaught)
01342           END IF
01343           !        PRINT *, 'the',n,' value of sig is:',sig
01344         END ASSOCIATE
01345       END DO
01346       !The total electron impact cross-section is the sum over the
01347       !cross-sections for the individual states.
01348       se_box%se_iontot = SUM(se_box%se_ionsigs)
01349 
01350       !(3) Calculate allowed excitation cross-sections
01351       !NB: the subroutine returns an array of values, so no
01352       !    loop is required
01353       DO n=1,SIZE(o2_e_ex_alwd)
01354         ASSOCIATE( e => se_box%se_energy            , &
01355             w => se_box%se_alwd(n)%wj_alwd   , &
01356             f => se_box%se_alwd(n)%fj_alwd   , &
01357             c => se_box%se_alwd(n)%cj_alwd   , &
01358             a => se_box%se_alwd(n)%alpha_alwd, &
01359             b => se_box%se_alwd(n)%beta_alwd    )
01360           se_box%se_alwdsigs(n) = pjgsigma(e,f,w,c,a,b)
01361         END ASSOCIATE
01362       END DO
01363       se_box%se_alwd_extot = SUM(se_box%se_alwdsigs)
01364 
01365       !(4) Calculate forbidden excitation cross-sections
01366       !NB: As above, no loop is required, since the subroutine
01367       !    returns an array of values
01368       DO n=1,SIZE(o2_e_ex_fbdn)
01369         ASSOCIATE( e => se_box%se_energy            , &
01370             w => se_box%se_fbdn(n)%wj_fbdn   , &
01371             f => se_box%se_fbdn(n)%fj_fbdn   , &
01372             o => se_box%se_fbdn(n)%omega_fbdn, &
01373             a => se_box%se_fbdn(n)%alpha_fbdn, &
01374             b => se_box%se_fbdn(n)%beta_fbdn    )
01375           !         se_box%se_fbdnsigs(n) = greendutta(e,f,w,o,a,b)
01376           se_box%se_fbdnsigs(n) = pjgsigma(e,f,w,o,a,b)
01377         END ASSOCIATE
01378       END DO
01379       se_box%se_fbdn_extot = SUM(se_box%se_fbdnsigs)
01380 
01381       !(5) The total electron impact excitation is the sum of the
01382       !    allowed and forbidden transition cross-sections
01383       se_box%se_extot = se_box%se_alwd_extot + se_box%se_fbdn_extot
01384 
01385       !(6) Calculate the total cross-section as the sum of the
01386       ! constituent cross-sections
01387       se_box%se_ineltot = se_box%se_iontot + se_box%se_extot
01388 
01389       ! FOR O !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01390       !(0) Initialize se_box
01391       !(1) Initialize variables
01392       n = 0
01393       ae = 0
01394       ge = 0
01395       tnaught = 0
01396       tmax = 0
01397 
01398       !(2) Calculate ionization cross-section
01399       DO n=1,SIZE(se_box%se_o_ionst)
01400         ASSOCIATE ( en  => se_box%se_energy           , &
01401             i   => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%i_energy, &
01402             k   => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%k_ion   , &
01403             kb  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%kb_ion  , &
01404             j   => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%j_ion   , &
01405             jb  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%jb_ion  , &
01406             jc  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%jc_ion  , &
01407             gs  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%gams_ion, &
01408             gb  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%gamb_ion, &
01409             ts  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%ts_ion  , &
01410             ta  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%ta_ion  , &
01411             tb  => se_box%se_o_ionst(n)%tb_ion  , &
01412             sig => se_box%se_o_ionsigs(n)          )
01413           IF ( en .LT. i ) THEN
01414             sig = 0D0
01415           ELSE
01416             !i. Calculate the A(E) value from Green & Sawada
01417             ae = a_gs(en,k,kb,j,jb,jc)
01418             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' ae=',ae
01419             !ii. Calculate the \Gamma(E) factor
01420             ge = gamma_gs(en,gs,gb)
01421             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' ge=',ge
01422             !iii. Calculate the T_0 value
01423             tnaught = t_0_gs(en,ta,tb,ts)
01424             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' tnaught=',tnaught
01425             !iv. Calculate the Tmas value
01426             tmax = t_max_gs(en,i)
01427             !          PRINT *, '#',n,' tmax=',tmax
01428             !v. Calculate the cross-section for the state
01429             sig = green_sawada(ae,ge,tmax,tnaught)
01430           END IF
01431           !        PRINT *, 'the',n,' value of sig is:',sig
01432         END ASSOCIATE
01433       END DO
01434       !The total electron impact cross-section is the sum over the
01435       !cross-sections for the individual states.
01436       se_box%se_o_iontot = SUM(se_box%se_o_ionsigs)
01437 
01438       !(3) Calculate allowed excitation cross-sections
01439       !NB: the subroutine returns an array of values, so no
01440       !    loop is required
01441       DO n=1,SIZE(o_e_ex_alwd)
01442         ASSOCIATE( e => se_box%se_energy            , &
01443             w => se_box%se_o_alwd(n)%wj_alwd   , &
01444             f => se_box%se_o_alwd(n)%fj_alwd   , &
01445             c => se_box%se_o_alwd(n)%cj_alwd   , &
01446             a => se_box%se_o_alwd(n)%alpha_alwd, &
01447             b => se_box%se_o_alwd(n)%beta_alwd    )
01448           se_box%se_o_alwdsigs(n) = pjgsigma(e,f,w,c,a,b)
01449         END ASSOCIATE
01450       END DO
01451       se_box%se_o_alwd_extot = SUM(se_box%se_o_alwdsigs)
01452 
01453       !(4) Calculate forbidden excitation cross-sections
01454       !NB: As above, no loop is required, since the subroutine
01455       !    returns an array of values
01456       DO n=1,SIZE(o_e_ex_fbdn)
01457         ASSOCIATE( e => se_box%se_energy            , &
01458             w => se_box%se_o_fbdn(n)%wj_fbdn   , &
01459             f => se_box%se_o_fbdn(n)%fj_fbdn   , &
01460             o => se_box%se_o_fbdn(n)%omega_fbdn, &
01461             a => se_box%se_o_fbdn(n)%alpha_fbdn, &
01462             b => se_box%se_o_fbdn(n)%beta_fbdn    )
01463           !         se_box%se_o_fbdnsigs(n) = greendutta(e,f,w,o,a,b)
01464           se_box%se_o_fbdnsigs(n) = pjgsigma(e,f,w,o,a,b)
01465         END ASSOCIATE
01466       END DO
01467       se_box%se_o_fbdn_extot = SUM(se_box%se_o_fbdnsigs)
01468 
01469       !(5) The total electron impact excitation is the sum of the
01470       !    allowed and forbidden transition cross-sections
01471       se_box%se_o_extot = se_box%se_o_alwd_extot + se_box%se_o_fbdn_extot
01472 
01473       !(6) Calculate the total cross-section as the sum of the
01474       ! constituent cross-sections
01475       se_box%se_o_ineltot = se_box%se_o_iontot + se_box%se_o_extot
01476       RETURN
01477     END SUBROUTINE esigma_suite
01478 
01479     SUBROUTINE p_ion_select(psigij,e_ion,e_se,thinghit)
01480       !
01481       ! Purpose:
01482       !   This subroutine is to determine the specific ionization state that an
01483       !  inelastic collision ionizes from.
01484       !
01485       ! INPUT:
01486       !   An array containing the cross-sections for the distinct continuum states.
01487       !
01488       ! OUTPUT:
01489       !   Two energies, in eV: the ionization energy from the selected continuum
01490       !  state and the kinetic energy of the secondary electron.
01491       !
01492       !! P_ION_SELECT !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01493       IMPLICIT NONE
01494 
01495       !Data dictionary: Input and output parameters
01496       DOUBLE PRECISION             , POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: psigij
01497       DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(OUT)                        :: e_ion,e_se
01498       INTEGER         , INTENT(IN)                         :: thinghit
01499 
01500       !Data dictionary: Local variables
01501       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: prob,prevprob
01502       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: sigtot
01503       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: rn
01504       INTEGER                                              :: n
01505 
01506       !(0) Initialize variables
01507       prob     = 0D0
01508       prevprob = 0d0
01509       sigtot   = 0D0
01510       rn       = 0D0
01511       n        = 0
01512       e_ion    = 0D0
01513       e_se     = 0D0
01514 
01515 
01516       !(1) Calculate the probabilities of each state based on the relative size
01517       !    of the cross-sections
01518       sigtot   = SUM(psigij)
01519       CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rn)
01520 
01521       e_ion = 1234567d0 !Just to know what's happening for debugging
01522       DO n=1,SIZE(psigij)
01523         prob = (psigij(n)/sigtot) + prevprob
01524         IF ( rn .GT. prevprob .AND. rn .LT. prob ) THEN
01525           IF ( (thinghit .EQ. ONUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. OSTARNUM)) THEN
01526             e_ion = o_p_ion(n)%i_epgion
01527           ELSE IF ( (thinghit .EQ. O3NUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. O3STARNUM)) THEN
01528             e_ion = o3_p_ion(n)%i_epgion
01529           ELSE
01530             e_ion = o2_p_ion(n)%i_epgion
01531           END IF
01532         END IF
01533         prevprob = prob
01534       END DO
01535 
01536       !(4) Draw another pseudo-random number, this time from a Gamma distribution
01537       !    to determine the kinetic energy of the low-energy electron.
01538       !
01539       !NB: The input to rgamma, aval, is a global parameter
01540       e_se = rgamma(AVAL)
01541       RETURN
01542     END SUBROUTINE p_ion_select
01543 
01544     SUBROUTINE p_ex_select(psigexj,e_exc,thinghit)
01545       !
01546       ! Purpose:
01547       !   This subroutine is to determine the specific excited state that an
01548       !  inelastic collision results in the target species being promoted to.
01549       !
01550       ! Note:
01551       !   The formalism in Edgar, Porter, & Green (1974) is used
01552       !
01553       ! INPUT:
01554       !   An array containing the cross-sections for the discrete states.
01555       !
01556       ! OUTPUT:
01557       !   In eV: the excitation energy from the selected discrete state.
01558       !
01559       !! P_EX_SELECT !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01560       IMPLICIT NONE
01561 
01562       !Data dictionary: Calling parameters
01563       DOUBLE PRECISION             , POINTER, DIMENSION(:) :: psigexj
01564       DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(OUT)                        :: e_exc
01565       !Data dictionary: Local variables
01566       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: sigtot,rn
01567       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: prevprob,prob
01568       INTEGER                                              :: n
01569       INTEGER         , INTENT(IN)                         :: thinghit
01570 
01571       !(0) Initialize variables
01572       e_exc    = 0D0
01573       sigtot   = 0D0
01574       rn       = 0D0
01575       prevprob = 0D0
01576       prob     = 0D0
01577       n        = 0
01578 
01579       !(1) Calculate the probabilities of each state based on the relative size
01580       !    of the cross-sections
01581       sigtot   = SUM(psigexj)
01582       CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rn)
01583       prevprob = 0d0
01584       e_exc = 1234567d0 !Just to know what's happening for debugging
01585       DO n=1,SIZE(psigexj)
01586         prob = (psigexj(n)/sigtot) + prevprob
01587         IF ( rn .GT. prevprob .AND. rn .LT. prob ) THEN
01588           IF ( (thinghit .EQ. ONUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. OSTARNUM)) THEN
01589             e_exc = o_p_ex(n)%w_epgex
01590           ELSE IF ( (thinghit .EQ. O3NUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. O3STARNUM)) THEN
01591             e_exc = o3_p_ex(n)%w_epgex
01592           ELSE
01593             e_exc = o2_p_ex(n)%w_epgex
01594           END IF
01595         END IF
01596         prevprob = prob
01597       END DO
01598       RETURN
01599     END SUBROUTINE p_ex_select
01600 
01601     SUBROUTINE e_ion_select(se_box,e_ion,e_se,null,thinghit)
01602       !
01603       ! Purpose:
01604       !   This subroutine is to determine the specific ionization state that an
01605       !  inelastic collision ionizes from.
01606       !
01607       !! E_ION_SELECT !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01608       IMPLICIT NONE
01609 
01610       !Data dictionary: Calling parameters
01611       TYPE(se_info)                                        :: se_box
01612       DOUBLE PRECISION   , INTENT(OUT)                     :: e_ion, e_se
01613       INTEGER            , INTENT(OUT)                     :: null
01614       INTEGER            , INTENT(IN)                      :: thinghit
01615 
01616       !Data dictionary: Local variables
01617       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: sigtot
01618       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: prob,prevprob
01619       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: rn
01620       DOUBLE PRECISION, ALLOCATABLE, DIMENSION(:,:)        :: arr,temparr
01621       INTEGER                                              :: n, arrcount,i
01622       INTEGER                                              :: incount
01623 
01624       !Ensure that there is not a null event
01625       null = 0
01626 
01627       IF ( (thinghit .EQ. ONUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. OSTARNUM)) THEN
01628         IF ( se_box%se_o_ineltot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01629           null = 1
01630           RETURN
01631         ELSE IF ( se_box%se_o_iontot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01632           null = 1
01633           RETURN
01634         END IF
01635       ELSE IF ( (thinghit .EQ. O3NUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. O3STARNUM)) THEN
01636         IF ( se_box%se_o3_iontot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01637           null = 1
01638           RETURN
01639         END IF
01640       ELSE
01641         IF ( se_box%se_ineltot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01642           null = 1
01643           RETURN
01644         ELSE IF ( se_box%se_iontot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01645           null = 1
01646           RETURN
01647         END IF
01648       END IF
01649 
01650       !Initialize values
01651       e_ion = 0D0
01652       e_se  = 0D0
01653 
01654       !Initialize integers
01655       n        = 0
01656       arrcount = 0
01657       i        = 0
01658       incount  = 0
01659 
01660       !DETERMINE WHICH TYPE OF TRANSITION WILL OCCUR
01661       IF ( (thinghit .EQ. ONUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. OSTARNUM)) THEN
01662         ALLOCATE(arr(SIZE(se_box%se_o_ionsigs),2))
01663         arr = 0
01664         arr(:,1) = se_box%se_o_ionsigs
01665         arr(:,2) = se_box%se_o_ionst%i_energy
01666         sigtot   = se_box%se_o_iontot
01667       ELSE IF ( (thinghit .EQ. O3NUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. O3STARNUM)) THEN
01668         ALLOCATE(arr(1,2))
01669         arr = 0
01670         arr(:,1) = se_box%se_o3_iontot
01671         arr(:,2) = o3_p_ion%i_epgion
01672         sigtot = se_box%se_o3_iontot
01673       ELSE
01674         ALLOCATE(arr(SIZE(se_box%se_ionsigs),2))
01675         arr = 0
01676         arr(:,1) = se_box%se_ionsigs
01677         arr(:,2) = se_box%se_ionst%i_energy
01678         sigtot   = se_box%se_iontot
01679       END IF
01680 
01681       IF ( SIZE(arr,1) .EQ. 1 ) THEN
01682         e_ion = arr(1,2)
01683       ELSE
01684         !Populate a new array with possible transitions
01685         DO n=1,SIZE(arr,1)
01686           IF ( arr(n,1) .NE. 0.0 ) arrcount = arrcount + 1
01687           IF ( n .EQ. SIZE(arr,1) ) THEN
01688             ALLOCATE(temparr(arrcount,2))
01689             temparr = 0
01690             incount = 1
01691             DO i=1,SIZE(arr,1)
01692               IF ( arr(i,1) .NE. 0.0 ) THEN
01693                 temparr(incount,1) = arr(i,1)
01694                 temparr(incount,2) = arr(i,2)
01695                 incount = incount + 1
01696               END IF
01697             END DO
01698           END IF
01699         END DO
01700 
01701         !Draw a random number and determine the precise amount of energy lost.
01702         CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rn)
01703         prevprob = 0d0
01704         prob     = 0D0
01705         DO n=1,SIZE(temparr,1)
01706           prob = (temparr(n,1)/sigtot) + prevprob
01707           IF ( rn .GT. prevprob .AND. rn .LE. prob ) THEN
01708             e_ion = temparr(n,2)
01709             RETURN
01710           END IF
01711           prevprob = prob
01712         END DO
01713       END IF
01714 
01715       !Draw another pseudo-random number, this time from a Gamma distribution
01716       !to determine the kinetic energy of the low-energy electron.
01717       CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rn)
01718       e_se = rn*(se_box%se_energy - e_ion)
01719       RETURN
01720     END SUBROUTINE e_ion_select
01721 
01722     SUBROUTINE e_ex_select(se_box,e_exc,null,thinghit)
01723       !
01724       ! Purpose:
01725       !   This subroutine is to determine the specific excited state that an
01726       !  inelastic collision results in the target species being promoted to.
01727       !
01728       !! E_EX_SELECT !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01729       IMPLICIT NONE
01730 
01731       !Data dictionary: Calling parameters
01732       TYPE(se_info)                                  :: se_box
01733       DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(OUT)                        :: e_exc
01734       INTEGER, INTENT(OUT)                                 :: null
01735       INTEGER, INTENT(IN)                                  :: thinghit
01736 
01737       !Data dicitonary: Local variables
01738       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: prob,prevprob,rn
01739       DOUBLE PRECISION                                     :: sigtot
01740       DOUBLE PRECISION, ALLOCATABLE, DIMENSION(:,:)        :: arr,temparr
01741       INTEGER                                              :: n, arrcount,i
01742       INTEGER                                              :: incount
01743 
01744       !Initialize values
01745       e_exc = 0D0
01746       prob  = 0D0
01747       prevprob = 0D0
01748       rn       = 0D0
01749       n        = 0
01750       arrcount = 0
01751       i        = 0
01752       incount  = 0
01753 
01754       !Ensure that there is not a null event
01755       IF ( (thinghit .EQ. ONUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. OSTARNUM)) THEN
01756         IF ( se_box%se_o_ineltot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01757           null = 1
01758           RETURN
01759         ELSE IF ( se_box%se_o_extot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01760           null = 1
01761           RETURN
01762         END IF
01763       ELSE IF ( (thinghit .EQ. O3NUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. O3STARNUM)) THEN
01764         IF ( se_box%se_o3_extot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01765           null = 1
01766           RETURN
01767         END IF
01768       ELSE
01769         IF ( se_box%se_ineltot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01770           null = 1
01771           RETURN
01772         ELSE IF ( se_box%se_extot .EQ. 0.0 ) THEN
01773           null = 1
01774           RETURN
01775         END IF
01776       END IF
01777 
01778       !Determine which type of transition will occur
01779       CALL random_number(rn)
01780       IF ( (thinghit .EQ. ONUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. OSTARNUM)) THEN
01781         prob = (se_box%se_o_alwd_extot/se_box%se_o_ineltot)
01782         IF ( rn .GT. prob ) THEN
01783           ALLOCATE(arr(SIZE(se_box%se_o_fbdnsigs),2))
01784           arr = 0
01785           arr(:,1) = se_box%se_o_fbdnsigs
01786           arr(:,2) = se_box%se_o_fbdn%wj_fbdn
01787           sigtot   = se_box%se_o_fbdn_extot
01788         ELSE
01789           ALLOCATE(arr(SIZE(se_box%se_o_alwdsigs),2))
01790           arr = 0
01791           arr(:,1) = se_box%se_o_alwdsigs
01792           arr(:,2) = se_box%se_o_alwd%wj_alwd
01793           sigtot   = se_box%se_o_alwd_extot
01794         END IF
01795       ELSE IF ( (thinghit .EQ. O3NUM) .OR. (thinghit .EQ. O3STARNUM)) THEN
01796         ALLOCATE(arr(1,2))
01797         arr = 0
01798         arr(:,1) = se_box%se_o3_extot
01799         arr(:,2) = o3_p_ex%w_epgex
01800         sigtot = se_box%se_o3_extot
01801       ELSE
01802         prob = (se_box%se_alwd_extot/se_box%se_ineltot)
01803         IF ( rn .GT. prob ) THEN
01804           ALLOCATE(arr(SIZE(se_box%se_fbdnsigs),2))
01805           arr = 0
01806           arr(:,1) = se_box%se_fbdnsigs
01807           arr(:,2) = se_box%se_fbdn%wj_fbdn
01808           sigtot   = se_box%se_fbdn_extot
01809         ELSE
01810           ALLOCATE(arr(SIZE(se_box%se_alwdsigs),2))
01811           arr = 0
01812           arr(:,1) = se_box%se_alwdsigs
01813           arr(:,2) = se_box%se_alwd%wj_alwd
01814           sigtot   = se_box%se_alwd_extot
01815         END IF
01816       END IF
01817 
01818       e_exc = 0d0 !Just to know what's happening for debugging
01819       IF ( SIZE(arr,1) .EQ. 1 ) THEN
01820         e_exc = arr(1,2)
01821       ELSE
01822         !Populate a new array with possible transitions
01823         DO n=1,SIZE(arr,1)
01824           IF ( arr(n,1) .NE. 0.0 ) arrcount = arrcount + 1
01825           IF ( n .EQ. SIZE(arr,1) ) THEN
01826             ALLOCATE(temparr(arrcount,2))
01827             temparr = 0
01828             incount = 1
01829             DO i=1,SIZE(arr,1)
01830               IF ( arr(i,1) .NE. 0.0 ) THEN
01831                 temparr(incount,1) = arr(i,1)
01832                 temparr(incount,2) = arr(i,2)
01833                 incount = incount + 1
01834               END IF
01835             END DO
01836           END IF
01837         END DO
01838 
01839         !Draw a random number and determine the precise amount of energy lost.
01840         CALL random_number(rn)
01841         prevprob = 0d0
01842         DO n=1,SIZE(temparr,1)
01843           prob = (temparr(n,1)/sigtot) + prevprob
01844           IF ( rn .GT. prevprob .AND. rn .LE. prob ) THEN
01845             e_exc = temparr(n,2)
01846             RETURN
01847           END IF
01848           prevprob = prob
01849         END DO
01850       END IF
01851     END SUBROUTINE e_ex_select

01853     SUBROUTINE elastic_event(energy,e_loss,labtheta)
01854       !
01855       ! Purpose:
01856       !   This subroutine is to determine the specific amount of energy lost by an
01857       !  ion in an elastic collisional event.
01858       !
01859       !! ELASTIC_EVENT !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01860       IMPLICIT NONE
01861 
01862       ! Data dictionary: Define calling parameters
01863       DOUBLE PRECISION             , POINTER :: energy !ion energy in eV
01864       DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(OUT)          :: e_loss !energy lost in the collision
01865       DOUBLE PRECISION, INTENT(OUT)          :: labtheta !lab scattering angle
01866 
01867       ! Data dictionary: Define local variables
01868       DOUBLE PRECISION                       :: afac !screening length
01869       DOUBLE PRECISION                       :: gamfac !mass factor
01870       DOUBLE PRECISION                       :: e_lss !Lindhard-Scharff-Sigmund red. energy
01871       DOUBLE PRECISION                       :: bfac !reduced impact parameter
01872       DOUBLE PRECISION                       :: c2,s2 !cos2(cmtheta/2) and sin2(cmtheta/2)
01873       DOUBLE PRECISION                       :: cmtheta !center-of-mass theta
01874       DOUBLE PRECISION                       :: rn !random number
01875 
01876       afac = au(ZP,ZO2)
01877       gamfac = mass_fac(MP,MO2)
01878       e_lss = eps(energy,ZP,ZO2,MP,MO2,afac)
01879       CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(rn)
01880       bfac = b_magic(rn,afac,RHO2)
01881       CALL magic(e_lss,bfac,c2,s2,cmtheta)
01882       e_loss = t_coll(energy,gamfac,s2)
01883       labtheta = lab_theta(cmtheta,MP,MO2)
01884       RETURN
01885     END SUBROUTINE elastic_event
01886
