01977     SUBROUTINE init_node(root,temp_node,x,y,z)
01978       !
01979       ! Purpose
01980       !   This is a subroutine that compares a string value to values
01981       !  in a list and gives the index of a matching result and an
01982       !  error if there is no match.
01983       !
01984       !! INIT_NODE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
01985       IMPLICIT NONE
01986       TYPE(node), POINTER :: root, temp_node
01987       INTEGER :: x,y,z
01988 
01989       temp_node%wait_time = 0.0
01990       temp_node%coord1 = x
01991       temp_node%coord2 = y
01992       temp_node%coord3 = z
01993       temp_node%sec_sp_num = 0
01994       temp_node%act_type = 0
01995       temp_node%hop_dir = 0
01996       temp_node%leftRight = 0
01997       temp_node%normal = .FALSE.
01998       temp_node%interstitial = .FALSE.
01999 
02000       NULLIFY(temp_node%before,temp_node%after,temp_node%parent)
02001 
02002       IF ( (MOD(y,2) .EQ. 1) .AND. (MOD(z,2) .EQ. 1) ) THEN
02003         INITIALATOMS = INITIALATOMS + 2
02004         temp_node%normal = .TRUE.
02005         temp_node%sp_num = 1
02006         CALL wait_calc(temp_node)
02007         CALL add_node(root,temp_node)
02008         ! Test for parent association
02009         IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
02010           IF ( (root%coord1 .EQ. temp_node%coord1) .AND. &
02011             (root%coord2 .EQ. temp_node%coord2) .AND. &
02012             (root%coord3 .EQ. temp_node%coord3) ) THEN
02013           CONTINUE
02014         ELSE
02015           IF ( .NOT. ASSOCIATED(temp_node%parent)) THEN
02016             PRINT *, "temp_node parent not associated!"
02017             CALL EXIT()
02018           END IF
02019         END IF
02020       END IF
02021     ELSE IF ( (MOD(y,2) .EQ. 0) .AND. (MOD(z,2) .EQ. 0) ) THEN
02022       temp_node%interstitial = .true.
02023     END IF
02024   END SUBROUTINE init_node
02025 
02026   SUBROUTINE wipe_node(x,y,z)
02027     !
02028     ! Purpose
02029     !   This is a subroutine that wipes a lattice site of species specific
02030     !  information, while leaving species independent information intact
02031     !
02032     !! WIPE_NODE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
02033     IMPLICIT NONE
02034     TYPE(node), POINTER :: temp
02035     INTEGER :: x,y,z
02036 
02037     temp => MATRIX(x,y,z)
02038     temp%wait_time = 0.0
02039     temp%sec_sp_num = 0
02040     temp%sp_num = 0
02041     temp%act_type = 0
02042     temp%hop_dir = 0
02043     temp%leftRight = -1
02044     IF ( ASSOCIATED(temp%parent) ) NULLIFY(temp%parent)
02045     IF ( ASSOCIATED(temp%before) ) NULLIFY(temp%before)
02046     IF ( ASSOCIATED(temp%after)  ) NULLIFY(temp%after)
02047   END SUBROUTINE wipe_node
02048 
02049   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE new_reaction(i,j,k,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02050     !
02051     ! Purpose
02052     !   This is a subroutine that handles reactions between two species and yields
02053     !  up to three products.
02054     !
02055     ! INPUT:
02056     !  i -> the coords of reactant 1 in matrix
02057     !  j -> the coords of reactant 2 in matrix (can be same as i in some cases)
02058     !  k -> the coords of the product to be placed in react cube
02059     !
02060     !  OUTPUT:
02061     !   i -> the coords of product 2 in matrix
02062     !   j -> the coords of product 1 in matrix
02063     !   k -> the coords of product 3 in matrix
02064     !
02065     !  NOTE:
02066     !   When this subroutine gets first called, k should be 1
02067     !
02068     !! NEW_REACTION !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
02069     IMPLICIT NONE
02070     INTEGER, INTENT(INOUT)          :: i(3),j(3),k(3)
02071     INTEGER                         :: pr_coords(3)
02072     INTEGER                         :: r1, r2, pr
02073     INTEGER                         :: error
02074     TYPE(node)            , POINTER :: root, temp, prevNode, nextNode
02075 
02076     error = 0
02077     SELECT CASE (k(3))
02078     CASE(1)
02079       r1 = MATRIX(i(1),i(2),i(3))%sp_num
02080       r2 = MERGE(MATRIX(i(1),i(2),i(3))%sec_sp_num,&
02081         MATRIX(j(1),j(2),j(3))%sp_num,&
02082         ALL(ABS(i-j) .EQ. 0))
02083       k(1) = r1
02084       k(2) = r2
02085       pr = branching(k(1),k(2),k(3))
02086       pr_coords = j
02087       IF ( pr .EQ. 0 ) THEN
02088         ! If there can be no reaction, delete species from tree
02089         temp => MATRIX(i(1),i(2),i(3))
02090         ! Delete node but DO NOT wipe it
02091         CALL delete_node(root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02092         ! Calculate new waiting time
02093         CALL wait_calc(temp)
02094         ! Re-add node to tree
02095         CALL add_node(root,temp)
02096         error = 1
02097         !          IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) &
02098         IF ( ISBARRIER .EQV. .FALSE.) THEN
02099           CONTINUE
02100           !            PRINT *, "Products = 0:",r1,"+",r2,"=",pr
02101           !            CALL EXIT()
02102         END IF
02103         RETURN
02104       END IF
02105       k(3) = 2
02106     CASE(2)
02107       pr = branching(k(1),k(2),k(3))
02108       ! If product is 0, then re-add hopping species to list
02109       ! DO NOT do this if i=j, i.e. an excitation with 1 product
02110       ! has occured
02111       IF ( (pr .EQ. 0) .AND. (.NOT. ALL(ABS(i-j) .EQ. 0)) ) THEN
02112         ! If there is only one product, clear the site of R1
02113         ! which now becomes a lattice vacancy
02114         temp => MATRIX(i(1),i(2),i(3))
02115         CALL delete_node(root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02116         CALL wipe_node(i(1),i(2),i(3))
02117         error = 0
02118         RETURN
02119       ELSE IF (pr .EQ. 0 ) THEN
02120         error = 0
02121         RETURN
02122       END IF
02123       ! if i=j, then non-special P2 overwrites P1
02124       IF ( (ALL(ABS(i-j) .EQ. 0)) .AND. (.NOT. ANY(SPECIAL_LIST .EQ. pr)) ) THEN
02125         ! Test to see if k(2) is EXCNUM, if so, and pr!=0, get new site
02126         CALL find_empty_site(j,i,error) ! save out-coords to i, NOT j
02127       END IF
02128       ! For all other cases (the second product can be at site i
02129       ! even when i=j
02130       pr_coords = i ! For species
02131       k(3) = 3
02132     CASE(3)
02133       pr = branching(k(1),k(2),k(3))
02134       IF ( pr .EQ. 0 ) THEN
02135         error = 0
02136         RETURN
02137       END IF
02138       IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "Third product=:",pr
02139       DO
02140         CALL find_empty_site(i,pr_coords,error)
02141         IF ( .NOT. ALL(ABS(i-pr_coords) .EQ. 0) .AND. &
02142           .NOT. ALL(ABS(j-pr_coords) .EQ. 0)) THEN
02143         IF ( debug .eqv. .true. ) then
02144           print *, "i=",i
02145           print *, "j=",j
02146           print *, "pr_coords=",pr_coords
02147         end if
02148         exit
02149       end if
02150     END DO
02151     IF ( (error .EQ. 1) .AND. (.NOT. ALL(ABS(i-j) .EQ. 0)) ) THEN
02152       ! If there are no empty sites around i, and i!=j, try j
02153       error = 0
02154       CALL find_empty_site(j,pr_coords,error)
02155       IF ( error .EQ. 1 ) THEN
02156         ! If there are no empty sites around either i or j, quit...
02157         PRINT *, "Unable to find a site for the third product!"
02158         CALL EXIT()
02159       END IF
02160     END IF
02161     ! At this points, when the subroutine quits, i=P1,j=p2,k=P3...
02162     !       IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "Third product coords are:",pr_coords
02163     k = 4
02164   END SELECT
02165 
02166   ! Once the case is selected, point to coords to place
02167   ! product
02168   temp => MATRIX(pr_coords(1),pr_coords(2),pr_coords(3))
02169   ! Place product
02170   IF ( pr .EQ. ELECNUM ) THEN
02171     ! Ensure that the electron is placed on the same site
02172     ! as the cation
02173     IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
02174       IF ( .NOT. ALL(ABS(i-j) .EQ. 0) ) THEN
02175         PRINT *, "Electron not placed on same site as cation!"
02176         CALL EXIT()
02177       END IF
02178     END IF
02179     ! The rest of the node should have a species on it already
02180     ! just add the electron as the secondary node species
02181     temp%sec_sp_num = pr
02182   ELSE
02183     ! Delete whatever is there, if the site isn't empty
02184     IF ( temp%sp_num .NE. 0) THEN
02185       CALL delete_node(root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02186       CALL wipe_node(pr_coords(1),pr_coords(2),pr_coords(3))
02187       temp => MATRIX(pr_coords(1),pr_coords(2),pr_coords(3))
02188     END IF
02189     temp%sp_num = pr
02190     CALL wait_calc(temp)
02191     CALL add_node(root,temp)
02192   END IF
02193 
02194   ! Call subroutine again, and check for next product:
02195   ! if the next product is zero, return
02196   IF ( k(3) .LE. 3 ) THEN
02197     CALL new_reaction(i,j,k,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02198   ELSE
02199     k = pr_coords
02200     RETURN
02201   END IF
02202 END SUBROUTINE new_reaction
02203 
02204 RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE new_electron(se_box,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode)
02205   ! Takes as input a "se-box" struct containing the initial electron energy
02206   ! and the coordinates at which it formed and does the following:
02207   !   1) Calculates cross-sections
02208   !   2) Hops the electron from inelastic collision at which the following can occur
02209   !      i) Electron impact ionization -> form a new electron and call self
02210   !     ii) Electron impact excitation -> chance of dissociating molecule
02211   !   3) When the electron falls below ECUTOFF, it reacts to form a negative ion
02212   !      which then reacts dissociatively with it's parent cation
02213   !
02214   ! NEW_ELECTRON !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
02215   IMPLICIT NONE
02216   TYPE(se_info) :: new_se_box
02217   TYPE(se_info) :: se_box
02218   INTEGER :: n,m
02219   INTEGER :: curr(3),next(3),prev(3),prcoords(3)
02220   INTEGER :: estep
02221   INTEGER :: eswitch
02222   INTEGER :: error
02223   INTEGER :: cation, anion
02224   INTEGER :: nhops
02225   INTEGER :: hopCoords(6,3)
02226   REAL               :: erand
02227   DOUBLE PRECISION :: emfp
02228   DOUBLE PRECISION :: new_e_energy
02229   DOUBLE PRECISION :: ee_loss
02230   DOUBLE PRECISION :: de
02231   DOUBLE PRECISION :: e_ion, e_exc
02232   TYPE(node), POINTER :: root,temp,prevNode,nextNode
02233   LOGICAL :: vacant
02234   LOGICAL :: react_with_parent
02235 
02236   ! Initialize energy losses
02237   e_ion = 0.0
02238   e_exc = 0.0
02239   ee_loss = 0
02240 
02241   ! Initialize coordinates
02242   prev = 0
02243   curr = se_box%parent_coords
02244   next = curr
02245   estep = 0
02246 
02247   ! Initialize switches
02248   eswitch = 0
02249 
02250   ! Initialize real variables
02251   emfp = 0
02252   erand = 0
02253   de = 0
02254   prevNode => MATRIX(se_box%parent_coords(1),se_box%parent_coords(2),se_box%parent_coords(3))
02255 
02256   ! Calculate track until the electron's energy is depleted
02257   DO WHILE ( se_box%se_energy .GE. ECUTOFF )
02258     ! Calculate cross-sections for transport calculations
02259     CALL esigma_suite(se_box)
02260     ! The electron's mean-free-path is a function of the total cross sections.
02261     ! Note: here, we have explicitly calculated the inelastic cross section and
02262     ! have approximated the elastic cross section to be 1.0E-17 cm^2
02263     CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(erand)
02264     emfp = 1./(RHO*(se_box%se_ineltot+1.0E-16))
02265     ! Determine the actual distance travelled
02266     de = -1.*emfp*LOG(1.-erand)
02267 
02268     ! Convert to integer value
02269     estep = INT(de/C_PR)
02270 
02271     ! If the estep = 0, force it to 1
02272     IF ( estep .EQ. 0 ) estep = 1
02273 
02274     ! Hop estep number of times until the next inelastic collision
02275     DO n = 1,estep
02276       prev = curr
02277       curr = next
02278       CALL transport(prev,curr,next)
02279       ! Calculate approximate elastic energy loss
02280       IF ( TRACKPLOT .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
02281         count_count = count_count + 1
02282         CALL trackwrite(curr,se_box%se_energy,se_box%generation,.TRUE.)
02283       END IF
02284     END DO
02285 
02286     ! Determine the nature of the inelastic event
02287     CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(erand)
02288     IF ( (erand .GT. 0) .AND. (erand .LE. se_box%se_iontot/se_box%se_ineltot) ) THEN
02289       eswitch = 1
02290     ELSE
02291       eswitch = 0
02292     END IF
02293 
02294     ee_loss = 0
02295 
02296     ! Based on collision type, perform action
02297     SELECT CASE (eswitch)
02298     CASE(1)
02299       ! Electron impact ionization
02300       temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02301       IF ((temp%sp_num .NE. 0) .AND. (.NOT. ANY(IONLIST .EQ. temp%sp_num))) THEN
02302         ! Calculate energy loss
02303         CALL e_ion_select(se_box,e_ion,new_e_energy,error,temp%sp_num)
02304         IF ( e_ion .GT. se_box%se_energy ) THEN
02305           CONTINUE
02306         ELSE
02307           ! Call random number
02308           CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(erand)
02309           ! Calculate new electron energy based on \DeltaE
02310           !             new_e_energy = erand*(se_box%se_energy - e_ion)
02311           ! Energy lost is sum of ionization energy + new electron energy
02312           ee_loss = e_ion + new_e_energy
02313           ! Ionize the species and call new_electron again
02314           ! Place CRP pseudo reactant at site to indicate ionization
02315           temp%sec_sp_num = CRPNUM
02316           ! Initialize 3rd set of coordinates to 1
02317           prcoords = 1
02318           CALL new_reaction(next,next,prcoords,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02319           temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02320           ! Now this site should have a cation and an electron as the secondary species
02321           ! at the same site
02322           IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
02323             IF ( temp%sec_sp_num .NE. ELECNUM ) THEN
02324               PRINT *, temp%sec_sp_num, &
02325                 temp%sp_num
02326             END IF
02327           END IF
02328           ! 1) Populate the se_box with initial energy and parent coords
02329           new_se_box%se_energy = new_e_energy
02330           new_se_box%generation = 1 + se_box%generation
02331           new_se_box%parent_coords = next
02332           ! 2) Call se_info_init to initialize the arrays in the se_box
02333           CALL se_info_init(new_se_box)
02334           ! 3) Call new_electron and send it on its merry way
02335           CALL new_electron(new_se_box,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode)
02336           ! 4) When it has lost energy and reacted back with its parent cation (above)
02337           !    we can free-up the arrays in the se_box
02338           CALL se_info_garbage(new_se_box)
02339           !    the species at the site above should now be neutral
02340           IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
02341             PRINT *, "At the end of the EII cycle, the site now has:",&
02342               MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))%sp_num
02343           END IF
02344         END IF
02345       END IF
02346     CASE(0)
02347       ! Electron impact excitation
02348       temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02349       CALL e_ex_select(se_box,e_exc,error,temp%sp_num)
02350       IF ( e_exc .GT. se_box%se_energy ) THEN 
02351         CONTINUE
02352       ELSE
02353         IF ((temp%sp_num .NE. 0) .AND. (.NOT. ANY(IONLIST .EQ. temp%sp_num))) THEN
02354           ! Place special excitation reactant at site
02355           temp%sec_sp_num = EXCNUM
02356           ! Initialize product coords to 1
02357           prcoords = 1
02358           CALL new_reaction(next,next,prcoords,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02359         END IF
02360         ! Energy lost is transition energy
02361         ee_loss = e_exc
02362       END IF
02363     END SELECT
02364     ! Deduct energy lost by electron
02365     se_box%se_energy = se_box%se_energy - ee_loss
02366   END DO
02367 
02368   vacant = .TRUE.
02369   prevNode => MATRIX(se_box%parent_coords(1),se_box%parent_coords(2),se_box%parent_coords(3))
02370   nhops = 0
02371   react_with_parent = .FALSE.
02372   hopCoords = 0
02373   curr = next
02374   ! Once the electron has fallen below the energy threshold, make
02375   ! Call transport until a non-vacant site is found
02376   DO n=1,6
02377     CALL hopping(curr(1),curr(2),curr(3),next(1),next(2),next(3),n)
02378     hopCoords(n,:) = next
02379     temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02380     ! Test to make sure that the species isn't some other electron's cation
02381     IF ( (temp%sp_num .NE. 0) .AND. &
02382       (.NOT. ANY(IONLIST .EQ. temp%sp_num))) THEN
02383     vacant = .FALSE.
02384     EXIT
02385   END IF
02386 END DO
02387 
02388 ! If no site has been found, expand the search region
02389 IF ( vacant .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
02390   DO n=1,6
02391     prev = hopCoords(n,:)
02392     DO m=1,6
02393       CALL hopping(prev(1),prev(2),prev(3),next(1),next(2),next(3),m)
02394       temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02395       ! Test to make sure that the species isn't some other electron's cation
02396       IF ( (temp%sp_num .NE. 0) .AND. &
02397         (.NOT. ANY(IONLIST .EQ. temp%sp_num))) THEN
02398       vacant = .FALSE.
02399       EXIT
02400     END IF
02401   END DO
02402   IF ( vacant .EQV. .FALSE. ) EXIT
02403 END DO
02404     END IF
02405 
02406     ! IF still no occupied site has been found, have electron react with parent
02407     IF ( vacant .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
02408       react_with_parent = .TRUE.
02409       next = se_box%parent_coords
02410       temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02411       temp%sec_sp_num = ELECNUM
02412     END IF
02413 
02414     ! Form anion, if a suitable target was found
02415     IF ( react_with_parent .EQV. .FALSE. ) THEN
02416       ! Electron reacts to form an anion with a surrounding species
02417       ! i=next,j=next,form negative anion
02418       prcoords = 1 ! Initialize k(3)=1 for the recursive subroutine
02419       ! Place electron at same site to form anion
02420       temp%sec_sp_num = ELECNUM
02421       curr = next
02422       CALL new_reaction(next,next,prcoords,root,temp,prevNode,nextNode,error)
02423       next = curr
02424       temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02425       anion = temp%sp_num
02426       IF ( (error .EQ. 1) .OR. (.NOT. ANY(IONLIST .EQ. anion)) ) THEN
02427         PRINT *, "Electron couldn't form anion!"
02428         PRINT *, temp%sp_num
02429         PRINT *, temp%sec_sp_num
02430         PRINT *, next
02431         next = se_box%parent_coords
02432         temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02433         temp%sec_sp_num = ELECNUM
02434       END IF
02435     END IF
02436 
02437     ! Make newly formed anion react with parent cation at %parent_coords
02438     ! i=next,j=parent_coords
02439     prcoords = 1
02440     prevNode => MATRIX(se_box%parent_coords(1),se_box%parent_coords(2),se_box%parent_coords(3))
02441     cation = prevNode%sp_num
02442     IF ( .NOT. ANY(IONLIST .EQ. cation)) THEN
02443       PRINT *, "Parent coords not a cation!!"
02444       CALL EXIT()
02445     END IF
02446 
02447     CALL new_reaction(next,se_box%parent_coords,prcoords,root,temp,nextNode,prevNode,error)
02448 
02449     IF ( error .EQ. 1) THEN
02450       PRINT *, "Ions couldn't recombine!"
02451       temp => MATRIX(next(1),next(2),next(3))
02452       PRINT *, temp%sp_num
02453       PRINT *, temp%sec_sp_num
02454       PRINT *, "ELECNUM is:",ELECNUM," and EXCNUM is:",EXCNUM
02455       PRINT *, next
02456       PRINT *, se_box%parent_coords
02457       CALL EXIT()
02458     END IF
02459   END SUBROUTINE new_electron
02460 
02461   SUBROUTINE analyzereaction(reactnode,speciesnum,yield,nature)
02462     IMPLICIT NONE
02463     TYPE (reaction) :: reactnode
02464     integer, intent(in) :: speciesnum
02465     integer, intent(out) :: yield
02466     character(30), intent(out) :: nature
02467     INTEGER :: tempreacts(2), tempprods(3)
02468     integer :: n, temp1, temp2
02469 
02470     temp1         = 0
02471     temp2         = 0
02472     yield         = 0
02473     tempreacts(1) = reactnode%nr1
02474     tempreacts(2) = reactnode%nr2
02475     tempprods(1)  = reactnode%np1
02476     tempprods(2)  = reactnode%np2
02477     tempprods(3)  = reactnode%np3
02478     nature        = "Neutral"
02479 
02480     ! Check for net yield
02481     do n=1,2
02482       if (tempreacts(n) == speciesnum) temp1 = temp1 + 1
02483     end do
02484 
02485     do n=1,3
02486       if (tempprods(n) == speciesnum) temp2 = temp2 + 1
02487     end do
02488 
02489     yield = temp2 - temp1
02490 
02491     if ( yield > 0 ) then
02492       nature = "Production"
02493     else if ( yield < 0 ) then
02494       nature = "Destruction"
02495     else
02496       nature = "Neutral"
02497     end if
02498   END SUBROUTINE analyzereaction

02503     INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: e_branch ! The generation of secondary electrons
02504     LOGICAL, INTENT(IN) :: electron ! TRUE if the particle is an electron

02515

02517       particle ,&
02518       energy   ,&
02519       coords(1),&
02520       coords(2),&
02521       coords(3),&
02522       PMODEL   ,&
02523       e_branch
02524   END SUBROUTINE trackwrite
